All in all the blueberry muffins were good.  They are not super-sweet like many store or cafe bought muffins, but they were still yummy.  The texture is soft and fluffy, not cardboard.  It was nice to have these as a low-carb treat.The only negative is that the package only makes 11-12 small muffins at 4 carbs each (1 muffin is a serving).  I used the standard cupcake sized silicon baking cups and only got 11 with none of them baking any higher than the top of the cups.  One won't fill you up enough to have as breakfast by itself, but they make a great snack in the afternoon or paired with some berries for desert.
The muffins taste great, the only reason they received 3 instead of 5 stars is they are a bit pricey.  However if you are craving some low-carb muffins these are a great choice!

column9: The muffins were a pleasant low carb treat
column10: As the subject said the muffins were a pleasant low carb treat.  I would by them again.

I made the fat-free version of these muffins according to the directions on the package.  The batter tasted good and they baked up really nicely.  However, they have a very strange texture and a weird chemical aftertaste.  I only ended up eating 2/12 and felt guilty even trying to give the rest away to a bunch of 20-year old college guys.  Sadly, I can't recommend them.  I generally love low cal subs, but this one sadly doesn't cut it.
Cardboard with bits of berry flavored chunks.  Nasty, chemical-ridden cardboard at that. It is just gross and should be avoided.
It is nice to have something to take the edge off this product will do that.  thanks.
If you could get over the weird, ugly color, these weren't half bad.  As a matter of fact they were kind of delicious.Definitely recommend for low carb counters.

Comes in 2 bags. I use so much garlic and onion powder for Italian food. I store this on the top shelf.  I fill up my garlic and onion shakers as needed.  I hate paying a lot for garlic powder and worse having to run out to the store for it.  I cut my cost and frustration level. Happy.

I bought this two bag order for under $14 and got free shipping.  The current seller has $9 tacked on to the price.  Wait for Amazon to put it back on, and get the real deal.  Fronter makes a really great line of products.

Every bit as good as what you buy in the grocery store, but only a fraction of the cost. If you can can split the order with a friend, the deal is even better. This is a lot garlic powder. I prefer using fresh garlic, but this is quick, easy, and inexpensive.

Back in 71 or 72 I chewed up five or six whole pieces of garlic ! The mouth crinkled up like cellophane ! The intensity was withering ! But the Pain in my gut was far far worse ! And the Panic of catching something was almost out of control ! By God when that raw garlic got through sinking its teeth in, that breath taking agony and fear just went away ! instantly ! A distant memory ! Well !! This Powdered Garlic( powdered ??) brought those memories back ! A heaping tablespoon in a cup of spaghetti sauce turned my stomach which made me feel SO GOOOD ! Putting it in the drinking water, and hot soups !! Love It !! Thank You !!!! Seasoning to taste is wonderful too!! It's not just all medicine !! Absolutely Wonderful !! Thanks Again !!
I use a lot of various spices in my cooking and wanted to find a source with a quality product at a reasonable price.  Frontier met that discription.

The consistency is very fine. Properly mixed it wont even think of acting lumpy in whatever you put it in.You'll want to have a container handy so you can protect it from moisture. Would hate to have it clump together.This is perfect for marinades and sauces.It is a little on the weak side though. Not sure why.

Freshen Up Peppermint Flavored Gum (12 count) Extrmely pleased with this product. It was a Christmas gift for my 15 year old Grandaughter,she was delighted!! The package was not damaged and arrived on time promised.I purchased this product before from this seller ,will purchase again without hesitation.annette

column9: A good gift for an acquaintince but not a main stage gift.
column10: I am somewhat biased in my review because despite ordering February 7th it came the day after Valentine's Day. Super saver shipping victim. That said, the box is exactly as pictured with a big puffy decorative bow. It's quite small. The bear is about the size of a beanie baby and the items inside were personal sized. I could see this going to a secretary or platonic style friend for Valentine's Day etc but if you forego roses for this gift basket your sweetie might dump the tiny packet of chocolate chip cookies on your head!

the tree arrived before expected with was great but when i opened it up i was a bit disappointed, it seemed like they had cut it to fit the box and the box was not very big, so now it has 2 cuts right at the top and i don't know what kind of shape it will take. Also soil quality doesn't seem like the "right" kind f soil for a potted bonsai. But overall okay with it, can't wait till it pushes leaves out in the spring. Hopefully.

column9: Great product at an affordable price
column10: I highly recommend purchasing japanese red maple bonsai from Bonsai Boy the shipment arrived earlier then expected and the tree was well packaged and in excellent health. All of my future purchases will be here.

Purchased a Bonsai that arrived a couple of days later than described however, shipping delays are understandable and not always the fault of the shipper.  The product did not match the description, however, the upon phone call the gentleman I spoke with informed me that the Bonsai would change colors and eventually be the color that the description listed.  After a month the color has started to slowly change.  Overall I am happy with their customer service and assistance, however, the description listed should have explained that the expected product would not be received and that the color would change after some time.

column9: Wow! Best gluten free crackers around!
column10: OK, so I've been coughing up $5 a box for these crackers and they were even worth it at that price. The box is small, you don't get a lot, and the texture is really going to be a change from any other regular cracker you've ever tried. Don't expect consistent sizes or thicknesses either. These are super crisp crackers that snap when you bite them. They have a very strong sesame flavor with an awesome black pepper bite; definately savory! These aren't water crackers or Ritz for that matter. Once you adjust to the strong flavor you won't be able to stop. Serve with a bold cheese for best results.

This is the taste I have been missing, a cracker with a full flavor. I can taste the flax and other ingredients. It is a delicious combination of flavor, and the cracker has a good texture. These could be topped with cheese, humus, or spreads.

These have always been my favorite cracker and I buy them by the 12 pack. The last 2 twelve packs have been noticeably lacking in black pepper! In fact they don't really have much flavor at all. I will get the Caraway or Original next time.

column9: Mary's Gone Crackers, Black Pepper, 6.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
column10: Any Mary's Gone are the best crackers on the planet!  Finally a healthy cracker that does not taste like cardboard.  I buy different flavors - they are all good.
These are the best crackers and cost 4 times as much at whole foods so thanks amazon they were awesome.

My husband and I moved to a healthier diet almost 2 years ago, removing all the simple carbs and refined sugars from our diet.  We searched for a whole-grain option to replace the white crackers (Ritz, others) that we loved and found these crackers.  We now order them by the case as we love them!
Addicted.  I really love these crackers.. they're very peppery, very crunchy.  The peppery flavor and the crunch really make for a good snack.  They satisfy my craving for a snack.

column9: The only glutenfree snack I crave
column10: I've never tried other ones, but this is our favorite. These cost so much in store, more than our typical meals but it's so worth it.
I partner these with humus for a delicious, healthy snack. Yum! This is a great price when you buy in bulk via Amazon, I was seeing them for over $4 a box in the grocery stores.

column9: best gluten free organic crackers on the market.  Thanks Mary
column10: I chose to be gluten free since I believe it is a better lifestyle but the hardest part is findingconvienent tasty foods.  I love these crackers my favorites are original and pepper.  Thanks Mary!

I have tried several kinds of Gluten Free crackers. These are the best. My favorite flavor is Black Pepper because they go with almost anything.  For the amount of calories I believe they have a good amount of fiber and protein compared with other kinds.  The best part is that they taste great!  Even my husband loves them and he doesn't need to eat Gluten Free!!  Amazon pricing is very good, especially if you do the Subscribe and Save program.  It took me a while to find out about the program and trust that it would be a good thing to do.  Now I order them through it every time and save an extra 15%.  Amazon is a great source for Gluten Free items.
This is the perfect gluten free cracker - always crisp and crunchy, and loaded with flavor, also completely nutritious.

This product has been such a delight. I have a gluten problem and love every variety of this line of crackers. I will reorder this again. It is so nice to find this available when so many people have a digestive disorder. Thanks so much for having this product.

My husband is allergic to gluten and these crackers are delicious. I serve them at my parties. Everyone loves them. My husband likes the Black Pepper ones the best and they are hard to find. We were so happy we could get them through Amazon. I would recommend them for anyone.

These crackers are my absolute favorite.  Wholesome and whole grain with a toasty crunch that can be a bit addictive.  Great with cheese and dips.  No refined flours or sugars added.  About as far away from a regular "saltine" as possible.

I didn't like these crackers at all.  They were (if it is possible) too crunchy.  Too many flavors and they fought with cheese and dips.  Seeds and hard and stick inbetween your teeth.  There are much better alternatives out there...

These are rice crackers and not very good ones. There are many other brands of rice crackers that are really moist and flavourful from Japan. If I had Celiacs disease I might consider having these around but you can't serve these to guests without a lot of explaining and some really sharp cheese. Be wary of making a 12 box commitment. Also these crackers come in a bag which means between 10%-25% are broken and they cannot be resealed which means they go flat very quickly. If you bought these and don't know what to do with them try opening the box and leaving it in the bathroom when you shower, it reduces the choking hazard. If you still can't adjust put them in a Zip-Lock and use them as packing material.

While they have a few mustards to choose from I picked this one solely as a dare, to the Fallot people, to disappoint me.  I've had their Dijon and their Dijon with Peppercorn so I knew that they knew what they were doing.  When I saw the Gingerbread variant I figured it was the LEAST appealing.  For me that is always a sign of a way to expand my horizons so I went for it.  It is excellent.  The more detailed ingredients include wheat and spices.  It's not the gingerbread taste I was expecting, which is a good thing.  It is dijon with a very unique zip to it.  I put it on ham with a whole grain wheat bread.  I prefer high tech ingredients like Boar's Head rosemary & sundried tomato ham but it's too delicate for this particular mustard so just use a basic high quality meat.  Serve it to yourself though, unless you know someone who is a total "foodie."  I paired it(LOL) with a French beverage in the form of a Citadelle gin martini.  Look to the French for food and art and you won't be disappointed,

I don't have a green thumb, so it's fortunate for me that this bamboo is inexpensive, while I learn how to grow it.I had purchased a vase with bamboo in it, from the local grocery store's floral department. The bamboo in it died (I THINK it was not my fault.. it was in bad shape when I bought it), but I loved the vase. So I just took this bamboo and put it in the vase. Looked so good and I still had enough bamboo, that I bought another vase and took the poor quality bamboo out to put this in. So far it seems to be doing well. I had enough bamboo left over to put in a third vase. It looks so good.Bamboo was packed well and looked great upon arrival, and came with a little bottle of the green bamboo liquid food.
the product is fresh tasting and enjoyed it. I had trouble with the lid which kept falling off and was soon lost.
I love Monin Fruit Puree, Mango, with my tea, fresh fruit, especially with mango!  It's super tasty with any snacks!!!

Among all of Twinings' breakfast teas, this has become my latest standard. Steeping for only three or four minutes produces a deep, full-bodied liquor, which I find to be a bit richer than English Breakfast (which is still a fairly stout tea unto itself). As it's such a strong tea, Irish Breakfast holds up very well to milk and sugar.If you're looking for a lighter morning tea, Twinings Ceylon Breakfast is very nice.

Did you know that the Irish - *not* the English - are per capita the world's highest consumers of tea? No wonder, then, that there is a breakfast blend named for them; although Irish Breakfast is actually strong enough to be a great pick-me-up throughout the day. Traditionally, it consists primarily of teas from Ceylon (Sri Lanka) and the state of Assam in northeastern India. Irish Breakfast has an intricately full-bodied, malty, floral aroma and goes particularly well with milk (or cream, but real milk is preferable). Enjoy!

makes a wonderful pot of tea and has a strong , bold, almost malty taste.  Nice strong cup of tea with excellent flavor.  I drink my tea with milk and sugar and this holds up well.  Have tried other brands but prefer this to others.  Also like the tin for freshness and ease of storage.

The flavor is ok but keep in mind this is very fine tea, as in not course enough for most loose leaf tea infusers. This verity should have been sold in tea bags instead of loose leaf form. Very disappointing.

I bought the loose leaf tea thinking that the Twinings brand would be good quality.  I was very wrong.  This tea has the look and consistency of instant coffee NOT loose leaf tea. I made one cup and threw it out, VERY DISAPPOINTING.If you want a decent quality loose leaf tea do not buy this.

column9: Weaker than teabag version, faulty Amazon advertising
column10: Twinings teabag Irish Breakfast Tea has four tea leaf rating while the English Breakfast Tea has three tea leaf strength rating, illustrated on the box.  The images of Twinings tea tins do not possess the strength rating, however, when I received my tins they both had three tea leaf strengths on the front of the tin.  I cannot explain the disparity in strength rating between teabag and tin for the Irish Breakfast tea.My reason for buying Irish Breakfast tea was for my first cup of tea, higher strength than their English Breakfast tea.  Amazon should correct this by getting Twinings to send updated images.  Similarly, written descriptions fail to indicate Twinings tea strengths using Twinings tea leaf rating system.  This should also be corrected.  My supplier's and Amazon's processing were both superlative.

These nuts used to be available at Sam's Club, but have been unavailable for well over a year.  I finally saw them on e-mail from Amazon and am thrilled with my order.  These are the tastiest Cinnamon Almonds around, at a much more reasonable price then you can find in local grocery store.  Delivery was swift and easy to order.

column9: Tasty, but be aware of nutrient content
column10: I like this product. I think it is quite tasty both to drink and over cereal, and I haven't had any problems mixing it (I shake it in a quart mason jar).  However, be aware that nutritionally, this "Vegan Beverage Mix" is not the same thing as liquid soy milk.  For instance, compared to Silk, it is lower in protein (2 g vs. 7 g), higher in carbohydrates (16 g vs. 8 grams), lower in calcium (8% DV vs. 30% DV), and contains no Vitamin D.  This isn't necessarily a bad thing as long as you know what you're getting, and aren't relying on it as a significant source of these nutrients.

column9: Best soy milk because it is so easy to use, store, and tastes great
column10: I use this straight into my coffee like a creamer, I mix it up for drinking, I use it for creamed sauces...great product.  I used to buy the boxed- Westsoy, Kikoman.  They are good but they take up a lot of room and I can't conveniently travel with them.  This soymilk is just as tastey and  travels without a problem.  I decided to make it my first item on Amazon's new autoship program.  However, be warned that the vanilla version is nowhere near as nice a product - mixes badly and doesn't taste as good.

column9: Best Soy Milk Product Out There!
column10: Ok I know what your thinking...soy milk...gag!I thought that way for a long time, but I really wanted to get off the cow juice for many health reasons.  So I started to try the various products out there and came away with a bad surprise - they were sweet!I guess in a attempt to deal with a perceived aftertaste many of the manufacturers have decided to add sugar.  Now I don't know about you but to me cow milk does NOT taste sweet - especially the 2% or 1% variety I was drinking previous to this product - so I didn't want my soy milk alternative to taste sweet either.I almost gave up the search until I tried this product.  I have purchased both the already prepared version of this product as well as the dry mix you just add water to and both versions DO NOT TASTE SWEET.  They are the closest thing you are going to find to the taste of real milk - especially when well chilled.I have tried the Silk Brand Unsweetened and there is just something too rich and creamy about it, the texture is wrong.  I can't quite nail it down - it just seems like something I would pour into coffee, not over my breakfast cereal.This is the better product - give it a try, I don't think you will be disappointed.

I love soymilk and thought this was a good way to save on $$$..however after a few weeks of trying this product by adding to coffee/tea (which is my primary use of soymilk), I can't drink it anymore.. The flavor is a little too "strong" for me, i think it tastes more like Vanilla rather than Plain...(can't stand vanilla)Will go back to buying liquid/fresh soymilk.

This really is the best.  We save quite a bit of money, it tastes like milk, not soy (which tastes fine but gets a bit tiring after a while).  I really believe in this product & I'm happy my girlfriend introduced it to me.  I'm not lying when I say this: our cat likes it too!

column9: Convient for everyday use and emergencies
column10: I'm a vegetarian who takes protein basically wherever I can get it. Most pre-mixed soy varieties you find in the grocery store, other than silk, don't agree with me. The price of these canisters where pretty good on amazon and I was looking for an emergency supply of soymilk for those times I can't run to the store. so I gave it a shot. And now I love it so much I basically have a can with me wherever I go.I have always have soymilk when I need, it taste great (some people may find it a little bland, but a tablespoon or two of sugar mixed shaken with 32 oz of water before adding the soy will take care of that), it convient, doesn't spoil, and I can add it to anything since heat doesn't affect it. A tablespoon or two in hot tea (with sugar) and another in some instant whole wheat oatmeal in the morning, and you have energy to burn first thing in the morning without taking the time to cook!

column9: Mixes better than the light version
column10: I normally buy the light version of this product but last time I ordered Amazon was out of the light so I got this.  For some reason this regular version mixes instantly whereas with the light you have to work at getting it mixed.  Still though I like the light version better, it just tastes better to me and I prefer the texture of the light too.  Good tasty stuff in strong hot tea.

I used to buy Lactose-free milk from the Supermarket and I can't handle the 'hard stuff'. I had tried Soy milk before but it was like drinking chalk mixed with water. What 'turned me' was Trader Joe's Original Soy milk which is just a perfect milk substitute; but they only sold it in 1/2 quart containers and the store was miles out of my way. Anyway, long story short I picked up a can of this stuff.It's teriffic! Very easy to mix...can even do it with a spoon in a glass of water. Has a great taste and best of all it's a powder so it keeps pretty much forever. I'm trying to live more healthily and this stuff makes the pefect base for my morning smoothie, tastes exactly the same as when I made it using milk, even works ouit cheaper (and higher in protein...well, a bit).

column9: Do you like baby formula and stale cardboard? Well have I got a drink for you!
column10: Wow - this is easily the most disgusting thing I've ever tasted. I am a huge fan of soy products - I drink Silk, I eat vegan cheese of all flavors, I love soy yogurt - I've even dined on tofu dogs. I'm not a vegan (or even a vegetarian), I have an allergy to milk. For the most part I have been able to find all kinds of great substitutes for milk and dairy products. Because of all the great reviews I decided to give this a shot. First of all, let me just say that the amount of money you are supposedly saving is at best a stretch of the truth, and at most a blazing lie. I live in a relatively small area (where grocery prices are normally really jacked up) and I can find Silk and many other brands of soy, rice and almond milks for this price or less. So you probably are not saving as much as they claim.Now, on to the taste. It's not just that it's bad, it's that it's SO BAD my stomach is still turning. I'm not sure why other reviewers are giving it a good rating... maybe they're of the mindset that if you buy something vegan it has to be gross, which may have been true 30 years ago, but simply isn't the case today. I've had all kinds of dairy free foods that were fantastic - milks, breads, yogurts, ice creams, puddings, sauces, creams, etc. and they all tasted great. There is no excuse for the taste of this. I'm not joking or exaggerating at all when I say it tastes like old baby formula and stale cardboard. And I know it's not just me - I tried this stuff on three other people. Two of them got as far as smelling it and then refused to taste it (good move since it tastes worse than it smells) and one of them braved up and took a drink... and then pulled a face and wiped his tongue on his shirt. My mother suggested that I try to cover up the cardboard taste... couldn't be done. Then she suggested I try it in baking... but there is no way I'm putting THAT taste into cookies or cake.And please don't misunderstand and think that maybe I just don't like the taste of natural soy because I assure you that I do - I love roasted soy nuts, they're great. That is NOT the taste I am describing here, this is something else. Seriously, old baby formula and stale cardboard...

This is the best tasting soymilk around, and you don't have to pay for water, as it comes in a powder.  It has an unopened shelf life of one year, so is great for food storage.  Purchasing through Amazon is also the best way to go, as I have never seen as low a price anywhere else.

It is tasty (like coffee mate which I actually like) but I'm afraid it's far less nutritious than soy milk or milk ---- 1 serving (23g powder) has 100 calories but only contains 2g of protein (26g of non-fat milk powder contains 9g protein!). And the list of ingredients for this product is long with several long words ...I will keep it but only as coffee creamer (To be fair, it is probably healthier than regular coffee creamer.) ButI don't think it is as natural, healthy, and nutritious as soy milk.

I have used Better than Milk for years. I am lactose intollerant. This product dissolves easily, tastes great, and can be mixed to your preferrence. It is getting hard to find in this area. Thanks Amazon!Johanna
I appreciate the convenience of mixing the amount I need.  It has good flavor and can be mixed to the strength of your liking.

I was happy to find this vegan alternative to powdered coffee creamers. Sadly, when I tried it the taste was quite unpleasant. I even gave it another shot in a second cup of coffee later that day, but by then the disgusting smell was such a turn-off that I couldn't even gulp it down. Looks like it's back to refrigerated non-dairy creamers for me. I am also frustrated that I had to buy this product in a two-pack--what a rip-off!

I bought this product because I was traveling out of the country.It is usually hard to find soymilk in some other countries & my luggage weighs too much if I bring "shelf stable" cartons of soymilk. So when I found THIS product, I figured it would be better than nothing. I was very surprised when I tried it........it's great!! It was not only better than nothing,but it was better than some of the other soymilk I have tried. This product will definately save me alot of time searching for soy in other countries. I found that using less water makes it taste more like regular soymilk. I made a qt at a time & kept it in the fridge, but you can also use it just like creamora & add the powder to your coffee & it will mix up perfect,too. I hope this helps someone else who runs into this problem when you travel.

When I switched to a vegan diet I needed to replace my favorite bread recipe which calls for dry milk.  I tried numerous approaches.  The Better than Milk, Soy is even better than the cow's milk.  My 9 year old granddaughter likes it better than store-bought bread...even with added flax seed and whole grain!  That says a lot.

column9: We love soy milk but this product is simply not tasty
column10: I bought this product expecting to use it during camping trips, but no one in my family of four could tolerate its flavor. I ended up buying individual aseptic packages of soy milk instead.

My family has gone through literally dozens of soy milk products, trying to find one that everyone likes.  The Better Than Milk is head and shoulders above the rest.  It isn't sickly sweet, doesn't have lots of flavoring trying to cover up the taste of soy, isn't real "beanie" in flavor, and is easy to make up in whatever quantity you need.  We keep a quart jar on hand that we can scoop a few spoonsfull of BTM powder, add the right amount of water, put a lid on it, and shake for a couple of minutes.  Voila!  Soy Milk!

I bought this to travel with as my son is allergic to dairy and needs something to eat his cereal with. I agree with the other reviewer that it does not have the protein( only 2 gms) and calcium( 8%) to compare with milk or soy milk so it would not be a good idea to drink it all the time in place of soy milk. But it makes for a great travel drink given the restrictions in carrying liquids aboard planes. It mixes easily in cold water and tastes fantastic. Yes, it does taste better than 2% milk.I figure it is better than nothing for trips to places which don't stock soy milk.

column9: Better Than Milk is the best tasting soy beverage we've found
column10: I became lactose intolerant some time ago, and it was a severe trial to have to quit drinking milk and switch to soy.  I didn't mind the taste of soymilk just to drink a small amount, but putting in on cereal or using it in recipes was out of the question.  Then we discovered Better Than Milk Soy Original.  It is not too sweet, and not too strong a soy flavor.  It's a beautiful creamy white color, and is the closest to drinking cow's milk that we've found.  Both my husband and I absolutely love it!  We don't even miss cow's milk anymore!  And buying the Better Than Milk through Amazon.com is very easy and convenient.

column9: Great for baking for a lactose allergy
column10: The shipping was great.  We got it the next day.  I used this in a recipe so that my allergic husband could enjoy the treat.  It worked great.  You couldn't tell it was soy.

I was not able to find this product at any of the stores that usually carried it.  I was so pleased when I found it on Amazon.  The product is actually better than what I was using.  It is well worth the money paid!
I like this product.  Easy to use, great for storage.

Our family has used this dairy-free "milk" for over 10 years now.  My husband has been lactose intolerant since college.  We have since had 2 children, now ages 12 and 10, and it is the only soy milk they will drink.  I really like the power because you can make it as creamy as you like.  I have also used it for cooking and it works great!  Our family highly recommends this product.  The only thing I wish they would add would be extra calcium to the mix...then it would be perfect.

column9: Just like powdered creamer that we grew up with
column10: We tried almost every vegan creamer we could get our hands on, that wasn't full of hydrogenated junk, yet I like my coffee very creamy without a bunch of floating powder in the cup.  This dissolves very nicely and tastes very creamy.  You can virtually not tell the difference between this and a non-vegan powdered creamer.  I highly recommend this!

I've had a lot of soy milks and this is the best, by far.  It truly is better than milk. I drink it every day and use it recipes.  It has never let me down.  Just shake or stir well when you get toward the bottom of the mixed soymilk.

I was introduced to Better Than Milk by a very knowledgable nutritionist when I was recovering from heart surgery. That was 11 years ago. I've used it twice daily since; in the morning on cereal, and before I go to bed with Ovaltine.I use only the original; don't care for the other flavors. This is TRULY "better than milk." One does NOT get any of the junk the dairies feed their cows. Try it!James R. "Jim" Stephens, author of CAMERA SOLDIERS: The Philippine Odyssey and THE WINDS OF OCTOBER.

column9: great product to have on hand
column10: i love this milk to have on hand .. i can use as much or as little of the soymilk as i need without wasting any

column9: This soy milk is pretty good!
column10: After hearing how many chemicals are in cow's milk, we decided to try a powdered soy milk.  This product is good.  After it's mixed you do have to shake it up before you use it each time, but that isn't really a problem.  We mixed it according to directions and it's good just like that.

I am very depressed... I really, really liked this product, but apparently their manufacturing locale has changed. The product still has parve certifications but there is a new warning on the label that I only noticed after drinking some and becoming uncomfortably stuffy. So, for those who are allergic to anything, I advise avoiding what once was an enjoyable product.Contains: Soy. Produced in a facility that processes or handles milk, eggs, soybeans, tree nuts, what, fish and shellfish.... Seriously, -shellfish-?! Granted, it's the milk that is a personal problem for me, but who in the heck thought that moving the manufacturing locale to a place working with pretty much all of the major food allergens was a good idea?

column9: Better Than MILK SOY Powder Original
column10: Convenient, delicious, useful - this soy milk powder is a staple in my kitchen and at the office. It needs no refrigeration, so a canister is in my office cubicle for a quick soy latte (add hot water and stir until foamy on top) or lovely creamy soup (combine soup base powder + soy milk powder then add hot water) or any one of a bunch of microwave recipes that are easy, quick and practical (a favorite is 1 envelope instant grits mixed with 2 Tbsp soy milk powder, add hot water, stir and let sit to thicken, add 1 tsp honey and enjoy). It's also yummy as a cold beverage, of course. Try pouring cold root beer over 1 or 2 Tbsp, stir, add ice, tastes like a root beer float and foams up, too (use a really tall glass or mug). Only two tablespoons makes eight ounces, so it goes far.

I'm sorry. I don't understand. This product was not good. I usually use almond milk in my morning oats and coffee, but I thought I would try something different that I could leave at room temp. Mistake. The powder kept falling out of solution in my coffee. So, I had this weird gunk at the bottom of my cup, then sometimes it would float to the top and make it completely unappetizing.

column9: I find the taste of this to be rather unpleasant and it is also difficult to mix
column10: I know that I'm in the minority here.  There are SOOOO many reviews stating that this stuff tastes great and dissolves easily in water.  I don't know if there's something "off" with my family, but we haven't found this to be true AT ALL.  The only reason that I'm giving it 2 stars rather than 1 star is because it can be used in recipes.  If one cannot have milk and needs something on hand for emergencies, it's not too bad in that aspect.I initially purchased one of these nearly a decade ago when I noticed that it was considerably cheaper than Silk.  I thought it'd be great to be able to save some money.  However, it didn't taste anything like other soymilk or milk replacements that I've had.  It wasn't quite as bad as infant formula, but it's not all that far off.  Four years ago, I decided to try this stuff again.  I figured that maybe my initial purchase had been a bad batch or that perhaps the company had changed the formula.  I had heard quite a few good things about this product as well.  However, I had the same experience as I had the first time.I also cannot get this stuff to mix completely.  No matter what tool or method I use, it seems like there are always at least a few chunks left floating on the top.  I also would like to mention that my mixing problems also were not resolved by using warmer liquid.  I'm not a professional chef or anything - but I'd like to think that I'm fairly good in the kitchen.  I'm able to prepare complicated meals and deserts.  I don't know why I can get this product to completely dissolve in water like most people can.
Product is great.  Highly reccomend for soy milk lovers.  I now have a place to go when my local store is out.  Delivery fantastic.
It is drinkable, but not super tasty to us.  We prefer the liquid soy milk much better.  This is ok in a pinch and tastes best if you use the blender to mix it.
I am lactose intolerant and purchased this to go in a chai tea recipe.  The taste is good and I am able to enjoy the tea without having to worry.

column9: Soy Milk Doesn't Get Much Better
column10: For this lifelong 60 year old vegan, the "Better Than Milk" original flavor soy milk doesn't get much better.I've used this product for close to 20 years.The "Original" has great flavor and no bean taste like some liquid soy milk.It's snap to use. I add it directly to many recipes dry. Add to dry hot chocolate mix and then just add hot water. Mix it right in your cereal bowl before adding cereal.It does take a little stirring to make smooth. Add more for creamier texture and taste. Very versatile.Cost is about the same as liquid soy milk but no worry about it going bad in frig. Just use it when you need it, it's always fresh.

column9: From zero to YUM in 90 seconds :)
column10: I love Soy milk.  Since I already use powdered fat-free milk, I wondered if I could find the same option for Soy Milk.  This product was a very pleasant surprise.  It mixes well and tastes great.  Much better than expected.  Now I can have it on hand when ever I want it. I use it for all my breakfast cereal, both hot and cold. You can mix to taste and make it as strong or light as you like.  I prefer the original flavor over the Vanilla, but that is just my choice.If you are looking for an easy way to have Soy milk anytime you like, this is the product you want.  I do wish they had this in one quart packets the same way dry regular milk is available, but getting 2 cans at a time is fine.

column9: Excellent for homemade soy hot cocoa mix
column10: This product is excellent for making homemade soy hot cocoa mix (a few family members are allergic to dairy) - we have not used this on its own. This mix is not easy to find in local grocery stores and Amazon made it a breeze to order and ship.BTW, the hot cocoa mix turned out great; make sure to use a good-quality baking cocoa (like Guittard). We followed Alton Brown's recipe () without the cayenne (for the kids). On a cold, blustery day, no one gets left out on the fun when they get asked, "Who wants hot cocoa?"

It took a couple days to get used to this, but now I like it a lot more than the expensive liquid soy milk.  With this, you can make as much or as little as you need, and as thick or thin as you like.  When I drank cows milk, I always had skim, and the liquid soy milk from the store seemed too thick and sweet to me.  I can mix this thinner just how I like it. Also if you go out of town for a week, you don't come back to spoiled soy milk and have to run to the store- you have as much as you need ready waiting to mix up.Its cheaper and I like it better than liquid soy milk.  Highly recommend.

I have been using "Better than Milk" for years and loving it. I live in a rural bush area of western Alaska and find it extremely difficult to get milk alternitives without forking over $500 for a plane ticket to Anchorage. I use the vanilla variety for all of my baking and drinking and cereal needs, the origional variety is good for teas and sauces. One container lasts me about 3 months and seems to make several gallons depending on how creamy you like it.

I think that this the product I received multiple times was not organic, meaning it could contain GMOs (genetically modified organics - google has lots of info) and that could be more dangerous to my health than worth. The products I have obtained never claimed 'non-GMO' on the package. Before I learned that difference though, I will tell you that this sure tasted excellent, and the price was likewise excellent.On another note, their rice milk product shouts 'Non-GMO' on the can. Thought it interesting to mention the discrepancy in labeling. Unfortunately I thought it tasted really strange, so onto organic liquid soy milk for me.

column9: My picky husband LOVES it in his coffee!
column10: This makes a great vegan substitute for coffee creamer. It has more calories, but it takes less, so it evens out for us. My husband insists on using "half 'n half" in his coffee, but he will use this (although he will not use regular powdered coffee creamer). Compared with "half 'n half," it's not really too much higher in calories, and it's "vegan!" I've also used it, reconstituted, in cooking with very good results. I recommend this product to anyone following a vegan diet.

The milk tastes great, I've used it for several years.  What's even better, now that my local health food shop has discontinued it, is getting it on Amazon.com and getting almost next-day service from this seller!!  The cost of this milk dry is way better than "Silk" or some already prepared in your grocery store.

column9: Updated - Tasty enough but weightwatchers be mindful
column10: After reading some of the reviews, I thought this soy milk might not be taste tolerable; however, I got a nice surprise. It tastes just fine. I think that the judgment of taste differs according to whether one is coming to this from cow's milk or from another soy product. I've been drinking soy, and more recently almond milk (unsweetened) for many years. Also, some complained that this is lumpy. There is totally no lumpiness using plain water and shaking (I used a shaker). I thought I was going to need a blender. In addition, this beverage will be a wonderful solution to having a milk drink while traveling. The nutrients are nearly the same as lowfat milk except for far less protein. I did not check for the vitamin D.On the less positive side if you are counting weightwatcher points, this beverage is 2 points; whereas my regular pre-mixed beverage is 1 point. The sugar content is high 5g; (although to my taste it is not overly sweet as some have complained). This beverage seems to have a very slight aftertaste.In summary, I am very pleased with the overall product; especially the cost savings, and the portability. The only reason I won't be using it daily is due to the sugar content.Updated opinion: I have to agree now that this beverage is too sweet, and the aftertaste is bothersome. So, I am only using it now in emergencies. Probably will not purchase more.

I wasn't too sure at first about this product. It seemed lumpy the first couple times I tried to mix it into coffee.  But I liked the convenience of being able to keep a baggie of powder in my bag - that way, I didn't have to deny myself a coffee when I was away from home.However, a recent vacation in Germany changed my tolerance into true love.As a newly-diagnosed celiac (intolerant of gluten and dairy) I can't tell you how WONDERFUL it felt to be able to enjoy my morning coffee while on vacation. I could stop whenever and whereever I wanted to even indulge in a second cup. We celiacs take the small joys where we can find them, and this product gave me such a feeling of freedom. It's a small thing, being able to have an impromptu coffee, but to me, it was a delight.  (Also, I was shocked at how hard it is to find soymilk in health-concious Germany, and how awful the taste was - I threw it right out)A semi-full snack-size ziploc bag of BTM lasted me for 10 days' worth of coffee. I don't know what my problem was initially, but with a little extra stirring, I didn't have any problem getting the powder to dissolve. It worked best if I tapped the spoon to sprinkle the powder onto the coffee, a thin layer at a time.  It really does have a closer taste to milk than most dairy alternatives and doesn't have a strong flavor - no "beaniness" at all.For cereal, it dissolves beautifully into room-temp water, if you put it in a jar, give it a shake, and let it sit for a minute.I will keep a stash with me from now on!

Being a frequent soy milk purchaser, I kind of assume that they're all organic (almost all of them are) and didn't even think to check when I ordered this product.  Unfortunately, Better Than Milk is NOT organic, meaning that I won't order it again.  I also thought it was bland and very thin unless I doubled the amount of powder suggested.

column9: Delicious and mixes like a charm!
column10: I make my own soy milk in my soymaker machine. However, there are times when I run out and need milk in a pinch. I also use this when I travel and camp. I place powder in a mason jar, add filtered water, shake for 5 seconds, and am rewarded with LUMP-FREE milk. Smooth texture, smooth taste, and nice color. This is the only powdered soy milk to drink!If you buy the asceptic containers or refrigerated soy milk, this is a bargain. The bonus is that is tastes wonderful! One container makes 8 quarts. Compared to homemade soy (less than 25 cents for 1.5 quarts), it is a costly.

I LOVE this Better Than Milk soymilk!  I have been using soy milk for about 14 years now and once I found this brand I have been using it excusively.  It isn't as sweet as the soy milk in the cartons and there is no waste; just make what you need.  I love it on cereal and I cook with it also.  I am on auto-ship as this is the best price I've found.

column9: It really is better than milk
column10: This Vegan soy milk really is better than milk.  It's easy to mix and easy on the stomach for those who are lactose intolerant.  Gluten free with all of the same vitamins as regular milk, and you can mix just enough so it doesn't go bad like regular milk.  I'm hooked!

I have been using this for several years as a substitute for dairy milk.  It works well as a replacement for milk, and is much more convenient than carring home quarts of liquid soy milk.  It's convenient.  One of my favorite products.
The product is great as well as reasonably priced! My husband drinks this all the time as he has a problem with milk. He loves it. It is also easy to mix.

I wanted to thank you for carrying the Better Than Milk powdered soy milk product. It tastes wonderful and I've been unable to find it since my local health food store stopped carrying it. I was surprised to find it at Amazon yet very pleased since Amazon is a trusted name to me. Thanks again.

column9: Becomes Sweeter The More Product You Use
column10: This product gets sweeter the more powder you add, whether it's adding to water to make soy milk, evaporated milk or heavy cream, or whether you're using it to make Ranch Dressing.  No sugar-like product listed in ingredients.  Maybe it's just me.

column4: K Hindall "Amazon forces period on 'Real Name...
column10: I am slightly vitamin D deficient, and my doctor recommended I drink milk to correct that.  I am, however, allergic to all animal milks.  I also don't drive a car, so liquid soy milk, being both large and heavy, can't be gotten in large quantities. I was hoping to solve the problem with this product.  I can't because there's no vitamin D in it.  I e-mailed the company that makes it and asked them to add vitamin D, but all I got was the standard "We'll pass your comments along" message.The product is good as far as taste goes, but nutritionally it's lacking a significant nutrient that most people get from cow milk: vitamin D.  Until the product does include it, I think it's misnamed.
my grandson can't have milk, and i live in a rural area. i can't get powdered soymilk in the stores. i found this product worth it's weight. he loves it it. thank you very much.

column9: W O W !  Tastes INCREDIBLY good, MUCH better than milk!
column10: I forgot the name of the brand when I first tasted this.  I scooped up a teaspoon of this powder and my first thoughts were, this tastes amazing!  Definitely better than milk!  I was expecting at best a good tasting product but a mediocre after taste or a not so great taste.  Then I mixed it with room temperature water and it mixes well and again incredibly good taste.For those worried about protein content please remember that muscular horses are naturally vegans so according to marketing lies they should look like scrawny thin animals and this is not so, the same goes for us humans.  Plus you can mix it with cereal if you like.My reason for buying this is because I love coffee as a mid morning snack and this is going to be an EXCELLENT substitute for cream (cholesterol) or non-dairy creamers (hydrogenated oils/fats.)Hopefully this product will not be sabotaged by a fake low rating from the competitors or people not noticing this product and it not getting the buying attention it very much deserves.  I've been a vegan for 17 years and I've NEVER seen such an outstanding and great tasting product that is powdered, mixes easily, is vegan, and tastes amazing.  If you love this product like I do (I know you will), pass it on and lets keep the ingredients as healthy as it now is.  The taste is so good I really don't think it could be improved further.Also, at first impulse I was going to buy the vanilla flavor but I read a review here that said this original version mixed better and the vanilla tasted too strong.  Well now that I'e tasted this one I don't care for the vanilla flavor anymore.  I guess you were right reviewer, thanks...

I've been adding this to cold fruit juice and/or water to use for making ice cream in an ice cream ball or a slush mug. Easy, and lovin' it! I've generally been using 13 ounces of powder with about a quart of liquid - but more or less is yummy too.

I purchased the powdered soy milk to use on a backpacking trip.  I normally use regular powdred milk but had a vegan on the trip.The powdered soy milk was great and only takes 2 TBS of powder for 1 Cup of milk.It worked out very well.

I've tried using other Soy milk powder but the flavor has been really strong.  I haven't found that with Better Than Milk Vegan Soy Powder.  You pay a little more for it, but I have found it to be worth it.

Easy to mix & tastes better than other powdered milks. No complaints about the flavor, tastes refreshing n not too sweet. NO Carrageenan which i think has caused many to have allergic reactions to soy milk. Good for camping or on the road w/ no refer!

when I ordered this product, I was looking for a healthy non dairy creamer in a powdered form.  I was sadly disappointed.  It seems to just clump, kind of nasty.  the only way to get it to blend in is to put it in a jar with a lid and shake it vigorously, not so appetizing for a creamy hot cup of mate'.  Anyway, experience is the key to knowledge.  I'll not make that mistake again.  $25.00 doesn't sound like much to some people, but it's a good chunk to me.

Couldn't find anything close to this locally with such a good taste.  Mixes well without lumps just by shaking.  I mix with Sugar-Free Carnation Instant Breakfast for a delicious shake.  Will buy again.

I use Better than Milk Vegan Beverage Mix in any recipe that calls for powdered milk.  I bake bread every week and use this product in that.  I am lactose intolerant and was looking for a soy powdered product when I found this.  I can recommend it highly.

Powdered soy milk?  Who knew it could be so delicious; and not only that, but good for you too. It's rich and creamy, and not at all like powdered milk. Mix it up as a beverage, or add it to oatmeal or smoothies, either way it's fantastic.  My kids love it.

column9: Good for what it does and is!
column10: This definitely has a better taste profile than the vanilla - we can barely use that because it colors our cooking too much.  It mixes well, hot or cold, but does leave a bit of chalky sediment.  If you don't like that, pour off the top into your storing/pouring container and leave the starch behind.  It tastes good, but younger folk are partial to adding something sweet.  But that is what's great, mix it how you like.  I just wish it had a better protein profile per 8 oz compared to Silk, etc.  I guess you can add soy protein to offset - that's why I dink it a star.  Great compliment to having some for food storage.
Since I don't drink milk cuz it's so nasty this is the BEST alternative to milk. and it almost never goes bad.  You make it when you need it....

I have been using BetterThanMilk powder Soy for a few years & find it much tastier than liquid soymilk that you purchase in grocery store. I can mix to the strength I like & the amount I need, so there is NO waste. It is economical & even more so with my purchase from Amazon.

column9: Tastes Pretty Good If Mixed Double Strength
column10: We have used this with our toddler during travel (it is terrorism free).  He is allergic to milk and we suppliment with soy milk.  This product does have a good, light taste and it mixes very easily with cold water or juice.  The problem is that there is NO WAY that the can makes 8 quarts of soy milk, well not any soy milk that anyone wants to drink.  At the 8 quarts concentration I can't imagine anyone using this soy milk for anything.  Now at 4 quarts concentration, its a different story.  If this is your expectation then you will not be disappointed with this product.
I love the soy milk! It is easy to use and store! I use them in milkshakes and hot chocolate! This is a perfect substitute to one who is allergic to dairy!

been using Better the Milk for over two years.  Its great.  I can mix the concentration i want and, since i buy 4 at a time can go a couple of months without buying more.  Works great is cooking, sauces, gravies, pies, whatever you use milk for.  I also live in a hurricane area so i always have a milk supply on hand should one strike.great product

column9: Instead of coffee creamer for 10 yrs
column10: I've used the original for 10 years or so. I use it instead of creamer in my tea and coffee and it tastes great and by-passes a lot of health concerns associated with regular creamers. I have also found it a great way to monitor my intake of soy products.The Vanilla reminds me of graham crackers (and seems gritty) and the Chocolate is more carob-y.  The issue of sugar that other reviewers have brought up is interesting. I remember comparing it against milk one time and seeing it was about the same.  I have friends that mix it with milk for "half and half".Since moving, I don't have access to my local supplier, "MOMS - My Organic Market".  I've asked Trader Joe's without any results and our local Giant stopped carrying it.  I've been using the liquids for four months - too costly and I can't store extra incase of bad weather.If I must, I'll order bulk.
This is a repeat order...we enjoy the product a lot.  Delivery was quick as usual from Amazon.  Dave

column9: Better Than Milk & Better than Soy & Rice Milk!
column10: I love this type of milk substitute.  It's one of only 2 tofu milks on the market that I know of & the OTHER one has both casein (a milk derivative) AND trans fat, so there's not even any competition in my opinion.  I like tofu milk better than rice milk, because rice milk is sweet, & I like tofu milk better than soy milk because it's lighter.  I don't like that thick, heavy beany taste of soy milk.  I've also tried potato milk (DariFree) & don't like the taste.  I think I got free super-saver shipping & had this in 2 or 3 days!  This wasn't long before the holidays, either.  I can only say good things about it!
Remember...this stuff is good if you make soymilk out of it.  But do not throw it at the bride and groom at a wedding, especially if it's still in the can.

I originally bought these at costco and loved that they were fresh and big pieces and my puppy ate them up, but when I got my package from you, the bag had a cut in it and the treats were not only puny, they were dry. It was disappointing. The price was good, but I thought I would be getting the same product.The reason I ended up ordering was because I had moved to a new state and this costco didn't have them...

Kingdom Pets Sweet Potato & Chicken treats are my teacup chihuahua's favorite. If you just mention sweet potato treats she's off your lap & running to the pantry. When I can give her something healthy, that she really loves.....that's a winner!!

These treats are becoming a favorite of my midsize Spaniel and me, too.  They are not too small or too big and one seems to satisfy as a celebration or reward.  And what a good feeling to know that they are healthy also.  Will buy them again when the bag gets close to empty.

column9: A Good, Portable Alternative to Artificial Sweetener
column10: I've seen liquid sweetener before but this was the first time I'd seen a Monk Fruit version of it. If you're leery of artificial sweetener then this may be a good alternative.The container is approximately the same size as a MIO (liquid flavoring for water) container. It measures about 2 3/4 inches high, 2.5 inches at it's widest point and approximately 3/4 of an inch in depth.I can easily fit this in my handbag and that's a huge plus to me because I have type 2 diabetes and the small packets of sweetener that most restaurants provide have maltodextrin in them which is bad for diabetics and as per my endocrinologist, anyone who has a family history of diabetes or is pre-diabetic should avoid that substance.This product comes in a sucralose version, a stevia version and the monk fruit. My favorite is probably the sucralose with the monk fruit being a close second.The downside: At the time of this writing, the price here is more than double what I paid for my container that I got at a brick and mortar store. However, I rarely take away stars for price because I feel that the review is about the product, not the seller/vendor and even if the seller makes the price more attractive, reviewers rarely come back and fix their review and I don't feel that's fair to the product.If you're looking for a good alternative to artificial sweeteners then you might want to give this a try.

I have been on a low carb diet for weeks now. I had found the yummiest low carb foods from online store: way2good4lowcarb and was doing fine, but looking for a sweetener for my coffee that didn't contain aspartame. This did it. I can't taste an after taste with it, but while others said they couldn't with stevia, I could. I am just hoping I don't get gas from it as that is my main problem. Will let you know if it causes tummy upset. So far, I am really enjoying it.

Warning to dog owners. I tried a new Dingo product, Dingo Chip Twists two weeks ago, and both dogs became violently ill within an hour of eating them. We were supposed to toss them but forgot and my husband accidently gave them to the dogs today with the very same reaction. I will contact the manufacturer, but wanted to warn all my dog lover friends to be aware.  It is really strange, as my dogs go through 4 - 5 bags of the mini dingo bones every month (they love them) and we've never had a problem. This product wasn't what I expected...it had a funky smell and it had a crunchy texture...it also didn't sit to well with my stomach if you know what I mean...I would not recommend this product...I still have some at home that I will just throw away...
These add no flavor to whatever you're cooking (which is great), but they are pretty expensive for the amount that you get

The person who left the previous review must not have followed the cooking instructions properly.. His noodles were overcooked. Also, these noodles contain a lot of soluable fiber which many Americans have very low levels of..So you should not eat a whole lot right off the get go if you do not normally intake fiber. I eat my veggies and just ate a whole package of the noodles. I feel great! They are delicious and I hope that people who need to make a serious diet change (or who just want to live a healthier lifestyle) will give them a shot!

Despite the poor marks given by the previous reviewer, I ordered this assorted Turkish Delight and was pleased with it.  I had just returned from a long trip to Greece and Turkey and missed all of the excellent food, so I decided to order this brand from Amazon, mainly because it was a whole lot quicker and more convenient than ordering it from one of the absolutely wonderful lokum shops in Istanbul where they've been making it for 150 years or so.  I see that previous reviewer had no idea what lokum was going to be like and had only been interested after seeing "The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe," so maybe that explains her extreme disappointment.  Turkish Delight is a very unusual candy.Is this as good as the perfect, authentic stuff I got in Istanbul?  Not quite, no.  But it was perfectly good and my office co-workers and friends were not shy about helping me eat up 4 boxes of it.  I will say that of the three flavors, the rose was my least favorite, although still good.  It was just a little strong in flavor - a lot more pungent than the rose pieces I had in Turkey.  The pistachio and lemon were quite tasty.All in all, I think this is a good product and well-priced.  If you like Turkish Delight and don't want to wait for an order to come all the way from Istanbul, get some of this.

Well I can say that you definitley get your moneys worth. I recieved 4 nice size boxes of candy more than I was expecting. I will be ordering more products in the future. The pastachio turkish delight was very good however the rose and lemon flavors were just a little to sweet for my taste. But over all I was satified with this product.

column9: Low nut content and just ok flavors
column10: While the candy portion was okay, the flavors were not particlaurly attractive. The nut content was practically nonexistent. Next time I would buy another brand.
I guess it was not the same hazer baba that I had originally eaten. It could have been better.. The pieces were bigger

column4: Janice L. Besser "music and old sitcoms colle...
column10: I have to say after watching the Narnia movie, I was curious about the turkish delight that Edmund so desired to have. Well I ordered some and my husband and myself were both disappointed with the product. Too make matters even worse, the order was for 4 boxes of this stuff. I took a box to work with me and this is the only food item that sat back on our break table for a whole week and only half of the box was gone. My husband had the same experience when he also took a box to his work. The flavors were not appealing to most including us. I would not buy any more of this product in the future.

column9: Dont listen to the other reviewers - THIS IS GREAT DIET SOUP!!
column10: If you have ever tasted Jenny Craig foods etc, you will know what dirt tastest like. It is absolutely discusting.BUT THIS SOUP LINE, is FABULOUS!!They are great sized portion containers, and contain extremely low calories/fat/sodium. The perfect treat or meal.
