Since I have started drinking Black Tiger each morning, everything else just disappoints me.  Black Tiger is bold, which I like, but it also has the flavor that lasts all the way to the end of the cup.  It is really one of those blends that stand the test of time for me.

This is hands down the best k cup out there. Great flavor, strong but not bitter, good bodied cup o joe. coffee people seem to have the best k cups out there. I do enjoy Newman's own special dark roast, but this black tiger is the best. Jet fuel is very similar, but not as good as this one>

When the labled this product "extra bold" they were not lying!  So far, it's the only coffee I've used in my Keurig where I changed the size of the cup so that I had more water.Perfect for Monday morning's or travel mugs!  Daily coffee I prefer something not quite so strong.  My housemate added hot water.
I like Dunkin's coffee.  Since no coffee is totaly consistant I find this brew at home to be nearly as good as the best cup from Dunkin. That says a lot in my opinion.

The flavor and strength is perfect for me. I like to have a very full cup at a time and with this coffee I run the Keurig large size setting followed by the small size setting (using the same K-cup) for a, full to the brim, delicious cup fo coffee.
Extra Bold Black Tigar Dark Roast is the coffee I keep coming back to and it always taste very good.
This is a decent coffee that is bold tasting up front, which I like, but then has a harsh aftertaste.  It is cheaper than the others, I didn't mind it, but it was not my favorite.

column9: Solid Dark Roast offering from Coffee People
column10: Coffee People Extra Bold Kcups are some of my vary favorites for using in my Keurig Brewer.I'm a Huge fan of strong , Bold dark roasted Coffee and Black Tiger delivers.

column9: k cups subscription Coffee People Black Tiger Coffee
column10: Great coffee at a great price, love the ease and the saving of the subscribe and save and getting my coffee fresh with free shipping.  All the Coffee People and Gloria Jeans k cup coffee are very great, I love the bolds the best.
The Coffee People K-Cup is a very bold coffee and a great pick me up for the early morning caffine jolt!
Great rich flavor. Long time user but a 25%breakage rate-never had cups do this before.I noticed the cups seem to be more "puffy"with air, perhaps this is the problem.

You may be wondering what is disappointing about a four star coffee.... This is a better than average brew, reasonably strong while not bitter (so no robusto beans), but the flavour, if "intense," it is not particularly rich. If you love Timothy's Rainforest Espresso & Parisian Nights, this coffee is not in the same league. It is similar to Green Mountain's bold roasts.

Most reviewers seem to find this coffee to be the best ever or just horrid. I thought it was just ok. A bit of a bitter aftertaste if you ask me. It's pretty much the same as Coffee People's Jet Fuel and Wake Up Call, I can't tell the three apart. Interestingly, their Donut Shop is fantastic -- if you like Coffee People (and you can't beat the prices here on Amazon), I'd go for that one.

column9: Raoring feel good wake up for boost for sure!
column10: I ordered this coffee because our staff requested a dark roast coffee. In particular,folks wanted something to help motivate and wake them up during early morning meetings because the flavored ones just didn't seen to have the punch in it needed for those early morning meetings. Well, this coffee was a hit and folks were purring and roaring and asking for me to order more. Great buy and great wake-me up!
this is the 2nd time i've ordered Black Tiger and there's a reason for it...it's GREAT!  no added flavor, just bold great tasting coffee.

column9: One of the better k-cups we've tried
column10: My wife and I have tried many different k-cup blends; Paul Newman, Green Mountain, etc, but this is, by far, our favorite.  Strong coffee with plenty of flavor, yet, not harsh.  A great way to start your morning.
My husband and I both love this coffee - favorite so far - bold and delicious!
First truly full bodied and strong coffee I have encountered with my new KCup machine.  Strong enough for the 11 ounce setting, coming from a heavy Starbucks/ Peets Coffee drinker...
I was looking for a smooth robust coffee and I have found it with the Black Tiger

I originally tried the variety pack that came with my Keurig and it had the Bold Organic from coffee people which was excellent-- I went online to buy some and saw all the great reviews for Black Tiger which steered me to buy it instead of the Organic. Boy, what mistake-- it was VERY bitter and I was stuck with two boxes of it!  If you like your coffee with a bite then go for it.  This is bitter even at the mug setting. If you like your coffee smooth avoid this like the plague! After two months of trying to use this up, I'm finally finished with it. I was the only one in my family that would go near it-- it was like swallowing a bitter pill every day.  Never again! I thought I should warn those out there from being swayed by bitter-coffee lovers.David
Excellent balance of intense dark roast flavor without bitterness. One of the most flavorful K-Cups around!

Good if you like a strong, bold cup of coffee.  My husband does, and he brews a medium size and a small size from the same K-Cup (with our Keurig B60,) into his travel mug and he's good to go. For me, it's way too bold.  I've since ordered him the Timothy's Columbian and he likes it even better - a bit smoother and more mellow taste, but not weak.  My preferences lean toward flavored blends.

column9: Black Tiger - One of my Favorites
column10: I drink my coffee black and prefer the bolder, stronger k-cups.  I don't like the french roasts or the other dark roasts, but I do like my coffee strong.  After having tried many different extra bolds, Coffee People's Black Tiger and Gloria Jean's Black Gold have become my favorites.  I alternate between the two of them and sprinkle in Green Mountain's Sumatran Reserve now and then which is also very good.

column9: Dark but not as full as I like
column10: This is a bold coffee which I bought based on another review.  It's OK, but I didn't find it to be as "deep" or satisfying as some of the other k-cups such as GM Sumatran Reserve or Timothy's Extra Bold Rainforest Espresso.  Tastes differ so if you like a strong, dark coffee, try it - it may be just the one for you.
Our guests and i really loved this one! Big bold dark yummy! I am always amazed at the quality of these K cup coffees.

*THIS* is the stuff right here!I had been going through a ton of K-CUP varieties trying to find a really good, strong coffee. I'm a bit of a coffee-snob and most of the K-CUPs I tried just left me saying "Meh... It's 'ok'. Not terrible, not great just 'ok'."Even the K-CUPs marked 'extra-bold' left me wondering who decided this coffee was even deserving of the name "slightly bold", let alone "extra bold". I usually found myself using 2 K-CUPS, and running the small cup size twice just to get 1 decent cup of coffee - and even then the flavor just wasn't quite "there" (to me, they always taste "old", as if someone ground halfway-decent beans but then left it out open and exposed to the air overnight to spoil.).. and then I picked up some Black Tiger.. Yeah!!! This is the *only* K-CUP I've found so far where I can choose the 12 oz brewing size and still get decent cup of coffee that doesn't taste like someone rinsed out my cup and served me hot water instead of coffee.Now even as such, this coffee is *still* not nearly as good as the cup of coffee that I can get with my good old french press using coffee that was roasted 2 days ago and ground 2 minutes ago. Sorry, ain't no way a K-CUP is going to get you that level of coffee. Ever.However, this variety is still darn good for a K-CUP and definitely deserving of my morning cup of coffee! (coming from me, that's saying *alot*!)
I love this coffee for my wonderful Keurig Brewer! I like strong coffee that is not bitter, and this one fills the bill. One of the very best available!

I've had the Keurig machine for almost 2 years now and have tried a lot of the flavors and Black Tiger is still the best out of all of them.  I like my coffee strong and flavorful and tried others with "extra bold" in their title and they are not as strong as Black Tiger.  It is the one I re-order more than anything else and I thought it's about time I give credit where credit is due.

column9: nice and strong, but too much carbon
column10: I do like dark roasted coffee -- but there's a thin line between dark roast and burnt to a crisp.  Maybe it was just the box I got, because so many people seem to like it -- but I tried several times -- and never got past the carbon ash taste.

column9: A good cup but problematic cups
column10: Good strong coffee.  The problem is with the kcups themselves.  In my keurig these are the only cups I've ever had a problem with.  After making my second cup of the morning there were coffee grinds in my coffee cup. Happened a couple of times.  No other brand has done that...might have been a bad batch in my box.  Nevertheless 3 stars for you.

The best I've had is Tully's Kona blend but this isn't bad.  Strong and smooth.It's been a year and half since I wrote that review and I'd give it a lower rating now.  While I still drink it for variety, I'd lower the rating to three because of its harshness.  Try Green Mountain's coffee.
Tiger Dark Roast is one of my favorite k-cups because it is bold yet smooth.  If you like a dark and rich cup of coffee, this one is a winner.

My husband and I agree that Black Tiger is one of the best dark coffees around. We've tried them all and were stuck on Rev until we tasted this. Coffee People does not make a bad coffee. So glad we can still get a good coffee from them since their coffee shops only exist in airports anymore.
This is my husbands favorite coffee to use in his Kureg, he loves a strong bold coffee and this fits the bill.

column9: Good, but not a personal preference
column10: Tiger Black is certainly a decent coffee with a bold flavor that will definitely perk up your day. I've just found that it's not to my personal taste; I don't like dark roasts as much as mediums, such as another flavor by Coffee People called Donut Shop. This is because the dark roast flavor overpowers the cream I use, while the Donut Shop is a good balance that I will gladly have every day.Don't let that discourage you: if you like dark roasts, this one may yet become one of your favorites.
This is all I drink out of my Keurig, very strong and tasty and wakes you right up.  Plus the design is very catchy too.

column9: The absolute best coffee I've had for Keurig
column10: This is probably the best coffee made for the Keurig single serve brewer. Bold statement, I know, but this is one bold coffee that stands apart from the mediocre "Green Mountain" blends that Keurig offers. This is a strong, in your face, wake you up, no holds barred coffee that I wish they made available in whole bean bags (or even pre-ground, it's that good) just so I could take it with me for when I didn't have my Keurig. The only downside is that it can get a little expensive, especially with how addictive it is to drink.I would NOT recommend this coffee for anybody that like to flower up their morning brew with sugar, cream, sweeteners, or heaven forbid those awful flavored creamers.If you like good coffee, drink this and you will not be disappointed.Written while sipping a cup of Black Tiger coffee.

column9: Excellent coffee , good price and fast shipping
column10: If you like strong coffee , this is one of them . I  drink this every morning , a good  wake up beverage.

Black Tiger is the tastiest dark roast the Coffee People produce. Smooth, not bitter, full-bodied... This is a great choice for dark coffee lovers that want to dip their toe in the wonderful world of Keurig. The dangerous name belies the smooth, fantastic cup you'll enjoy in the morning.
Great value and taste.  The coffee taste is bold and not bitter.  Not a fan of starbucks.  This stuff is strong, mellow and has a rich flavor.
This is one of my all time favorite brands. This is for "real coffee lovers!"  I like a good strong cup of coffee in the morning and this fits the bill.

column9: One nasty cup of Joe.....it even smells bad
column10: I was looking forward to a nice bold cup of coffee and for the extra price I thought it might be good.  It was nasty and I could not even drink it.

column9: If you like your dark roast coffee, this is the best we have found
column10: We have had our Keurig about 6 months now.  Overall, we think most of the coffee selections brew pretty weak coffee.  If you know anyone from Louisiana, this is not going to cut it. We like our coffee dark and heavy.  With that in mind, we have tried just about every dark roast coffee available.  This is by far the darkest we have found with bold flavors that live up to the larger cup size.

I got a good deal on this from the Amazon warehouse, so I jumped on it.  I'm not at all disappointed.  While it's not the best coffee in the world, it's what I consider to be a very good dark roast.  I would compare it favorably to Starbuck's dark roast, but maybe not quite as bold.I'm not much of a coffee snob, so I can't really give much more of an in-dept review, aside from it's a good dark roast.

column9: coffee people black tiger dark roast k cups
column10: I tried these kcups because the reviews were good. It is a very good high quality coffee and very smooth, but as far as being xtra bold it was not. Its not weak but not xtra bold like most said it was. I usually drink emerils exbold, or green mountain dark magic these are the two I would recommend for those who like a very ,very strong cup of coffee. also tullys italian roast is also another kcup I recommend for bold coffee drinkers. I am waiting for a delivery of green mountain double black diamond I will make sure i give a review when I taste it lol.

This is one of my favorite kinds of coffee for my Keurig. It has a nice dark taste that is not overpowering while still being strong. My mother hates strong coffee and when she comes to my house she will resuse one of these K-Cups after I've made mine to knock the punch out. Whatever your pleasure, I guess!

I've been trying K-cup varieties for the last three years and this is the one!  What I like about Black Tiger is that it's dark but not bitter, strong but not overwhelming.  I just think the taste is perfect.  I'm done searching.

This coffee is a great, strong blend that simply tastes great. Amazon has this at just the right price (~60¢/k-cup). I can honestly say that I will never buy a k-cup again that is not made by Coffee People. Absolutely thrilled with my purchase. For an idea of how this tastes, it's in between Dunkin and StarBucks, leaning much more toward StarBucks.
Strong, robust, just what it takes to get me going in the morning. Easy to order at Amazon. Try it!  Coffee People Black Tiger K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50)

A lot of K-cups say they are strong. I've tried many - Emeril, REVV, GM French Roast, etc. Many have a weird side taste or are bitter.Not Black Tiger! It is strong and smooth and my go-to when I need the caffeine kick-in-the-pants. I hope they never stop making this product.

This coffee is burnt tasting.  Like burnt toast.  The burnt taste overpowers the other flavors that may be there.  Not much coffee flavor detectable, reminds me of and old fashioned large percolator, after several hours, only more burnt tasting.  I have not had this problem with any other K-cups.  This one, Black Tiger, stands out as the worst tasting.  Adding milk added will not mask the overwhelming sour, bitter and chalky flavors.  I have tried it several times over the past 2 years, so I think I have sampled a few representative "batches."  My wife, who prefers the darkest roasted coffees, consistently complains about the taste, and drinks it only as a last resort.  She drinks a lot of coffee, and I see her point.Try any other brand, Donut Shop, Dark Magic, French Roast, any other brand is much more drinkable.  Maybe some folks appreciate the burnt taste.  If you like the taste of burnt toast, then you might like "Black Tiger."
Black Tiger K- Cups are awesome. My Wife and I enjoy the coffee. Gonna have to order more. K-Cupsarrived on time without a hitch. Good Stuff!!!!!!!!!!

Being a coffee lover, I have found that many of the K-Cup offerings are a little weak for me. I tried a few of their Bold Coffees, but when I found the XBOLD - Black Tiger, I stopped looking further. And I was much better off buying through Amazon as the price was better than retail or via Keurig.

I bought this coffee for my son who loves his coffee stronger than I do and he loves it.  He said the flavor was very good and I will be buying more.  After he uses one of these bold black tiger k-cups he leaves it for me and I use it a second time and it is very good for me and not as strong which I like so this has worked out for both of us.  Would definitly buy more and recommend if you like your coffee more on the strong side but not bitter.
I have this coffee. It is not the best coffee I ever had. It not as strong as other coffees. I would prefer French roast.It does not give you much energy.  THE END
was not sure I would be keeping my machine since I really love a dark roasted cup of coffee.  This one fits the bill and now I love my machine AND the coffee it makes.
I prefer bold coffees.  I like Emeril's bold the best.  If I don't have Emeril's or don't want to spend the $, this is a good alternative.
This is one of the best if you are looking for a bold tasting cup of brew from your kuering. I will be a repeat buyer. Good price for a nice tasting coffee.

Had been looking for just the right coffee that matched my whole bean favorite blend [Seattle's Best Sixth Avenue Bistro].  Tried around 15 different pods, and this is the one that did it for me. Great, robust, flavor.  Try it!

I grew up in Seattle and Starbucks French Roast is my addiction. Since it is not available in K-Cups I have tried every kind of french roast or dark roast K-cup and found this one. For those who like strong dark roast, this is the best.
I have found my nitch with this coffee...It is really bold and delicious...If you are looking for a good wake-up coffee this is for you...I really like this one a lot!

Good coffee.  Typically we like Diedrich French Roast coffee and we thought we'd try something new.  Bold, but no bitter aftertaste - that's a plus.  Sometimes, bold coffees are bitter, but this is smooth.  Worth a try.

I enjoy "extra BOLD BLACK TIGER" coffee by Coffee People.  If you like strong smooth coffee, then "BOLD BLACK TIGER"  is the coffee for you!Wish you would sell this and other K-cups I purchase in case qty's andcase price.  Coffee People K-Cup Extra Bold Black Tiger, Dark Roast Coffee, 25-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)

column9: Not Extra Large, but Extra good
column10: We ordered these for a big family celebration.  I think the word large is very objective.  To me I would not call them large, they are just normal snail size.  But the can does say the count is 72, and we had about 10 bonus snails.  They also were very very tasty and a big hit.

This used to be the only cat food my 2 cats would eat.  I ordered this from Amazon, because I was having trouble finding it in the supermarket.  Harmony must have changed the ingredients.  Now my cats won't eat it.  I would check with harmony to see what has changed before ordering this.  The old cans had a goldtone top, and that is the formula my cats loved.  The new cans which I am convinced has been changed, has a silvertone top.  Very disappointing.

Good product, as I was looking for Parmesan/Garlic flavor without too many additives and chemicals.  Sadly enough, there are not too many producers for this chip flavor that aren't all heavily chemicaled.

I've found that Onion Sprouts are one of the fussiest to grow....no matter Who's seed you buy...mainly because they take AT LEAST two weeks to reach proper eating size...as well as they tend to hold onto the seed hull but its not going to hurt you to eat them.I normally soak for about 6-8 hours then drain. What I DON'T do is always rinse them every day...it really depends on how much moisture I still see in the sprouter..if I see beads of moisture I might skip a day. Then the next day I will give them a 5 or 10 minute soak instead of a quick rinse.The flavor of them is worth the time and effort.

My favorite sprouts are onion sprouts, which take a bit longer to sprout than most, but are really, really yummy.Finding untreated onion seeds at a price that allows sprouting regularly is tricky.  These are a good value and keep me in onion sprouts all winter.

column4: Sewnmachine "A good dog, a sewing machine, an...
column10: I'm an old hand at growing my own sprouts. But for some reason I can not get onion sprouts to grow well. It's not just this brand ( although I had hoped this one would grow for me ) it's all brands of onion sprouts. I have even soaked the seeds over night. After several tries I have given up. Unless you have some magic formula, or extra green thumb - save your money and go for a different sprouting seed.

column9: Bacon, bacon, bacon, bacon, i want bacon
column10: I used to buy these packs from the grocery store, now I will never buy from the grocer again. These were 100x more fresh than the store bought ones I was buying. Perfect on my salads at lunch.
Great-tasting crumbled REAL bacon.  I use it on everything from pizza and salads to omelets.  Very fresh and you will not be disappointed . . . especially at the price.

column9: Product expires in a month and a half
column10: I haven't tasted the product yet, so I can't comment on that. I just received the order today, having had it shipped to me to Canada through a third party (MyUS.com)and the expiry date on the product is Oct 21 2012. Ridiculous! I think one should be able to see the expiry date of the product before ordering. I ordered these for backpacking and portaging trips, so I may not even have a need for them before the expiry date. I'm glad I only ordered one package of six instead of ordering more like I had the intention of doing.The size of the individual packages is great. Each has 70.87 grams. Serving size is 7g so there are 10 servings per package. A package can be consumed by one person if they want a really big serving, or more reasonably split between two people. Each 7g serving has 30 calories, 2g of fat, 5mg of cholesterol, 190mg of sodium, and 3g of protein.

Listen, if you want bacon that taste the old fashion way, this is the one for you. I know bacon, my dad cured his own bacon and sausage in his smoke house in the 1950s and 60s. I like to eat foods that taste the way it suppose to taste. No bland tasting food for me, thank you! Amazon did a good job finding this brand. You can use this for any purpose as you use store bought regular bacon, but this bacon has more flavor.

Having previously tried the "Hormel" version of these Bacon products, these do not come close.Uneven quality in the same bag.  If you add it to a sauce, some pieces become knots of string.The Flavor is not bad, but I would not buy these again.
This is my go to snack... what more can i say I bought 12 pounds and it's gone.. Movie food... Just bought another deal for same movie food...

If you LOVE strawberry Twizzlers... this is YOUR dream come true!  Six, 2 pound packages... amazing!!!  The only problem was not with the candy but with the shipping dept... they only sent one package instead of six... but I informed them of the situation and got not just the 5 packages that I needed to complete the order but an extra one as well, and the Twizzlers still made it in time for our Christmas open house!  They were a huge hit... fresh & tasty and the resealable package is a great idea on such large quantities.  I will buy again!

column9: Not bad, but too much chocolate and not dark enough
column10: Really 3.5 stars would have been more fair.  I ordered these along with the same brand milk chocolate beans.  Both bags suffer from a high chocolate to bean ratio (personal preference, but I like a thinner coat of chocolate), but the dark chocolate beans are also a little hard to distinguish from the milk.  The milk chocolate is decent and not-too-sweet, but these dark chocolate beans could use a higher cacao content to differentiate them in my opinion.That said, these bulk bags are a great deal and a handful works wonders for waking up in the morning.
Alot of chocolate; not so much coffee bean.  Not as big of a caf-kick as I'm used to w/chocolate covered espresso beans.

This is a flavorful pouch of baby food. It tastes better than Sprout's pasta with lentil bolognese, that had no flavor. If you eat bland and boring food at home then your baby probably won't like this pouch of red lentils.  We eat all types of foods in my house ("ethnic" as the other reviewer describes, and American) so this was naturally a hit for my babies. I would go so far as to say that the red lentils taste authentic, just without the hot spice factor.  I also like that it is a large portion of food (5.5 ounces).

I was excited to have some new flavor options for textured baby foods, but this one didn't deliver. The flavor combination was not favorable at all to my 11 month old. Perhaps I was too zealous on introducing her to ethnic type foods at her age. I'm not sure I know many children who would favor such a flavor combo and it didn't even smell very appealing to me! Perhaps we are just picky eaters in our home, but this was not preferred by us. I would recommend buying one pouch as I did to try it before investing in a case of them.

I got this tea from a holistic health store and it had me feeling better the first day. Highly recommended for cold/fever relief. I am happy to see Amazon sells it in bulk because I want to send some to the family!

I gave this tea to my son, one day when he had 103° fever and a cold, together with oregano oil for his sore throat. Next day the fever was completely gone and my son completely healed. I bought it from another place, but it was exactly the same as this.

I received my Kraft Grey Poupon Bistro Sauce and it was already out of date. I called the manufacturer to find out what the date code meant...and it seems that the product that I received was already out of date by 3 months.Date code on my Bistro Sause was 07M2402 meaning 07 is July, and 24 is the day of the month, and 02 indicates 12 for 2012...so again my product was best by July 24, 2012 and as I write this, it's October 22, 2012. I've had the product since the 10/21/2012...yesterday.The product, itself didn't taste as I remembered when we had it at our local restaurant.  But, that's probably because it's old. Kraft customer service told me to return it and not to use it.Here's the date code so that you can figure out your best by date.07M2402 is July 24, 2012 (QUICK REFERENCE)So, mine is going back.

I just received my order and both bottles of Grey Poupon Bistro Sauce expired May 2, 2006.  Why would anyone ship out six + year old merchandise???  I called and they are re-sending, hopefully with unexpired dates.  I must say the the representative that handled my call was most helpful and polite.

As a gourmet food truck on Long Island NY (Mogo Chef), we need to try different products. Although I would rate the Seller as 5-Star, the product did not live up to our high standards over the past several months. This of course has nothing to do with the Seller as he does not manufacture the product. Again, I have no problem with the Seller.

Because this product is a food service product, I expected a simple chain restaurant style sauce.  However, I was pleasantly surprised by the depth and bite of the flavor.  No specific flavor overwhelms, but it still has a nice strong flavor, with a hint of both horseradish and garlic - with the garlic having a tiny bit of raw garlic bite.This is certainly thick enough to be a fine dipping sauce, but thin enough to be easily spreadable on sandwiches and would nicely incorporate into a salad dressing.  This is mostly smooth and creamy, but with very small pieces of mustard seed and possibly garlic and onion.  It seems somewhat reminiscent of a country style mustard/thousand island dressing/french fry sauce mixture, but much tastier than that sounds.The best thing it has going for it (hence the 5 stars), is that along with its great taste, there really is nothing else on the market like this. It is quite unique.I have eaten this on chicken sandwiches, but think it would be excellent with most meats - including seafood, any fried food, most vegetables and excellent on most vegetable salads.  I also think that mixed with honey or jelly, it would make a wonderful glaze for chicken and pork (maybe with some ginger added to the pork).  I am also tempted to mix this with maybe some honey, lemon juice and cream cheese as a dip for fruit.

column9: Did Kraft discontinue thsi product in 2008?
column10: I found this in my local Good Stuff Cheap store for $2.00, but since they're pretty careless (or underhanded) with expiration dates, I contacted Kraft for information on reading the expiration code.  "08M13C8 16:07" stands for August 13, 2008.  Imagine my disgust to find it online for 3 times that price and see the identical date code!  BEWARE OF CRAPITALIST PIGS!

column9: Great product with great convenience factor
column10: I found these for sale at Wal-Mart, and I would recommend getting them there unless an online price changes and happens to out do the convenience of buying local.  For 24 bottles I paid about $30.Onward to the product review.So I have been using these off and on since our baby boy was born in the hospital, where they supplemented him using this product while his mothers breast milk came in.  Today almost a month later we are still using this product.I have had some mixed results with this product, causing my son to have some gas, reflux, spit-ups, and rare vomiting (although not exclusively Enfamil's fault), but for the most part he seems to keep this down and enjoy it.  It also seems to mix fairly friendly with his moms breast milk, so if my boy is really hungry I can confidently give him both and not cause issue.If you can get around the price, reason with yourself, because let me tell you how convenient this product really is: The product comes in a ready-to-go bottle, and all you have to do is attach a screw-on nipple.  This is perfect for when you are up at 3AM feeding your baby (when you are tired as hell) and you have no breast milk around, or when you're out and about and you just want to quickly feed your baby.I have had great success using this product with my son versus using another powdered make-it-yourself product, wherein my baby was much more pleased to drink and digest this product from the latter.The shelf life is pretty good because you can keep this bottle out at room temperature for an hour, and store it in the refrigerator for about 2 hours or so.  Honestly, that's great because it is often the case that your baby is going to drink the entire bottle or close to it when you start your feeding anyway.So although the price is not as cheap as some others... the convenience factor, paired with the amount per bottle for a feeding, really makes this product worth it.  This is the only formula product I buy my son at the moment, and it seems to be working quite well.
These are available at Walgreens and Babies R Us for about a little under $9 per 6-pack.  A case of 4 x 6 packs is only $33 or so.

My dog was placed on a special food diet. Where I live, I couldn't find this canned food..Now I got it for her and she's a happy camper..She loves this canned food. I mix it with her dry food and she eats every last morsel..Thanks...
This food is remarkable in too many ways to put here in the review. Try it you won't be sorry.

My boxer loves these treats. They are great because you can break them into several different pieces and fit them into different sized toys. Big bag has a lot of treats in them so it should last awhile. They are dry so they tend to crumble pretty easily but nothing the little furry vacuums cant pick up.

column9: Can't make them this good at home!!
column10: I'm very particular about what I feed my dogs. I often make my own "canned/wet" food and treats at home to ensure the quality and safety of the food I'm feeding my dogs. After looking at the ingredients in these biscuits and checking out the price when purchased in the 12 pound box, I realized I could not make biscuits of this quality at home for this price. My dogs really love these biscuits, and I feel good about the quality of this product. I also love that I can divide these biscuits into various sizes, as I have dogs that range from 6 lbs to 130 lbs. Even with 5 dogs this 12 lb box lasts a long time, and it is packaged in 3 heavy zipper bags, so you don't open all 12 lbs at once and they stay fresh. I would recommend these to anyone who cares about what they feed their dogs.

column9: Good for dogs on raw diet
column10: My doggies eagerly look forward to their 'Biscuits' every day.  We feed raw turkey and chicken and these are used as a treat.  Getting them from Amazon is the most economical way for us and they are not all broken like boxes we have picked up from pet stores.

I have 2 dogs a Golden and a black lab pup 9 months that love these biscuits, you can break them into 4 or 8 pieces just turn them upside down to the cut to snap them. The girls love them so much that I've taken to breaking them in half after there snapped into 4 pieces so they don't gain weight

I have known for a long time that Canidae is a great product, and is not usually sold in stores, so when I saw these biscuits on the Amazon website, I immediately ordered them.  I have two Eskies (miniature American Eskimo Dogs) so I had to have enough for both of them.  This is a big package, so it was definitely enough.  Canidae is so highly rated for both dry and "wet" food that I didn't have to worry about these biscuits containing anything that might not be good for my Girls.It has "Balanced Omega 6 & 3 Fatty Acids" and they are advertised to help control tartar and plaque.  Can't speak to that yet (neither has had a dental for a year) but I do know they love them.  It's a single biscuit that can be snapped into 4 separate pieces.  My Girls, both under 26 pounds, receive 2 half-pieces in the mid-afternoon (that's 1 biscuit broken into 2 pieces) and although one of them trots off with her half-piece as soon as she gets it, the other stands right where she is and crunches down the first half-piece and looks for the next one (just about demands it!).As the package ran low I knew I had to have more for them, and so re-ordered from Amazon.  Another package duly arrived, before the first one ran out, for which I was thankful.  And so were The Girls!

The Canidae Dog Treats, Lamb and Rice flavor, is the best treats for my dogs.  I have been feeding these treats to my dogs for years, and they are still the best.  They are snap biscuits so I can regulate how much I give them at a time, and guard against weight gain.  I use the Lamb and Rice because one of my dogs has an allegery to chicken and wheat.  I have never had a problem with Canidae Dog Treats, as they are healthy and safe to feed my dogs. I have been feeding the Canidae Dog Treats for well over 20 years and I plan on continuing to do so as long as I can still get the 12 pound box, as I have Big Boys to feed.
great dog biscuits. not super easy to break apart, but easier than most. dogs love them. they smell great too!
While I do think these treats are healthy and nutritious, they are on the large size. I generally break them in to 4 pieces (the biscuit itself is scored), and then break them again for the treat.

The Canidae dog treats has been well received by my 1 year old Presa Canarios.  The "snap" configuration of the treat works great since you can break off as much or as little as you want.  I liked the nutritional content of the treats.  So many times the dogs may love the treats but they are not the healthiest for them.  These treats are good for them and they love them.....  I have switched my dogs to the Canidae dog food as well.....

I have been buying these Canidae treats for a while now for my dogs.  I feed them the same formula Canidae kibble and canned food, so these treats fit in well with their diet - no worry about upset tummies.  They smell kind of nice too, almost like cinnamon.  There is usually a good amount of crumbs at the bottom of the bag which I just sprinkle in their food bowls at dinner time.  I'll continue to buy these for my dogs for as long as they make them.

I have fed Canidae All Life Stages food for several years to my mixed dog collection, with great results, but for some reason, had not offered the Snap Biscuits.  Finally, I purchased a bag and offered them up.  Well, they must taste treat-like because they gobble them up, and have evidenced no digestive upsets.  Safe and tasty is the verdict.  My test group is aged two years through 10 years, size eight to twenty-five pounds, in generally good health.

column9: Great Value, A Little Broken Up
column10: I was looking for a bulk price bargain on my preferred premium dog biscuit for my two Vizslas & this definitely met that criteria. Canidae's Snap Biscuits always have some bits and pieces in the bottom of the bag, which is understandable since the biscuit is a snap variety. I was afraid the larger quantity might mean more waste & I was right. There were three (3) plastic 4# bags in a large single cardboard box to comprise the 12#, so they must shuffle a bit & in the end the amount of tiny bits & powdery crumbs in the bottom of each bag was a significant amount of waste. Though I'm sure I could use the wasted crumbs in their food bowl, I am very careful to watch their food intake at meal time.I love the nutrition & quality of Canidae's Lamb & Brown Rice Snap Biscuits, but I will likely stick with the single 4# units in the future, which are packed in individual bags.

I decided to try these treats because the reviews were so good and the price was great. That and the fact it is such a well known brand I had high expectations.  I have a 10 month old Weimaraner that I thought would love them, however he rates it a 2 star. I was hoping he would be a little more excited about them. They are a larger treat so I break them up into smaller pieces. They also have good things in them.  Most of the time he will eat the treat. Others times he will take it and then drop it in the living room and come back to it later. I will not be getting them again.
chips cousin teddy eats canidae dog food and treats. chip only likes the treats. i like the idea that he is getting his 'greens'

column9: Great natural product to clean the liver
column10: I have always deposited a lot of faith in natural remedies, mainly because they work. A sour orange, boiled which water is drank in the mornings for seven consecutive days... or boldo leaves are my best option. And this brand has great fresh boldo leaves that clean my system in a most natural way. The tea bags are very well presented, they taste like old teas (grandma style) and I recommend this brand for selling what is a great product and even if boldo doesn't taste great, that's how it must be, with its own way to clean bile and a fat liver. I have bought other brands and at times they are almost tasteless. This one is pure and natural. A great remedy through a most healing mother nature. Thanks.

If you have gall bladder symptoms this is a traditional South American herbal tea that can help. Some people have no gall stones and yet they have right quadrant abdominal pain. (One possible cause is a Candida infected Sphincter of Odi.Yes there is such a valve, just Google it!) Taken between meals two or three times a day for about two weeks should do the trick. Also see my review of Natures Way Primadopholis. I have not heard of any side effects from this tea, other than it's unusual natural taste. Of course if you have severe pain in the gall bladder area you should be checked by a doctor as an inflamed gall bladder could burst. And you should have a scan to see if you have gall stones. I have found this tea to be very effective using it in 2004 and 2012. Salud!

I purchased this product as an alternative to a rawhide. Our 5 month old German Shorthair Pointer puppy ate it in a matter of 6 minutes or less. She loved it, but it was more of an expensive treat.With a puppy, I needed something to satisfy her chewing urge. The treat fractured into small bits all over the floor but our dog was willing to pick those up. The pieces looked rather sharp and that was a concern. Others mentioned it was made in China and I would like to add the first ingredient is corn.  It might last longer for very small dogs.

Good product, but more of a treat for my dogs.  It took them just a matter of minutes to have the SmartBone gone.  Maybe good for dogs that are not big chewers.  I was hoping for something more digestible but as sturdy as rawhides

column9: Safer than rawhide, don't last as long but also cleans teeth
column10: I picked these up from my local pet shop for a bit cheaper than what they are on offer for from Amazon, so you might wish to shop around.Over all I am quite satisfied with these "bones." They are much safer than raw hide chews given they are made from dried chicken, which means unlike raw hide you know these are actually digestible. This is the biggest reason I bought them. My vet recommended not giving my Sheltie raw hide as they aren't properly digestible. Whether this is true or not, I've heeded her advice.Baird, my Sheltie, really seems to enjoy them. When he sees one coming out of the bag, his tail is wagging like crazy. He enjoys these as much as our old family Sheltie McGyver enjoyed raw hide. The only difference I see between these and raw hide is that raw hide lasted roughly 30 minutes longer in chew time than these. I'd say Baird can chew through one of these in about 30 or so minutes, while our old Sheltie could chew on a single raw hide for an hour, at which point we would throw away the little nub. There is nothing left of these bones after 30 minutes.As far as the dental application goes, it does smell of mint, so I assume it should, if nothing else, help with doggy breath, though to be fair Baird has never really had "doggy breath." I also use some dog mouth foam so I don't know what really keeps his breath "fresh" between the two.If you aren't too sure about raw hide for your dog and want something you know can be digested, these are definitely worth it.For those that try to keep track of where the things they give their dog come from, these are made in China. I've tried finding something similar not made in China, but it seems such a thing doesn't exist or I just can't find them.

Great product but made in China. Once I realized this after purchase, I got a little worried. Kind of over priced in the regular retail market. My dogs like it & have been ok but I wish I knew ahead of time where it was made.
SmartBones Dental Dog Chews are the perfect treat for my two pomeranians and one Pembroke Corgi. No rawhide, nothing to upset their sensitive stomachs. They "dance" when I give them their daily chew.

The girls lost their taste for rawhide, but were still looking for something to chew. They love these Smart Bones, and they are better for them as well. I will be reordering them when there gone!SmartBones Chicken Dog Chew, Mini, 24-Pack
Read your labels, people!!! SMART bones are made in China!!!!!! A neighbor told me how great these were. After buying them, I read the fine print in the back. "Made in China!!"
there wonderful, my dog loves them, and I feel good giving them to him, I will always get these for him.
My dogs just love these and the chews are safe for them. Their breath benefits from the mint and their dental exams show much less plaque . I must keep bags on hand; they expect them.
I have given this bone to several different breeds and sizes of dogs and it is a major hit! And I don't worry about them choking on it as you do with rawhides. LOVE this product and will buy more!

column9: picture of the package of the dog chew is not what I recieved
column10: If you open the link to the Smartbones you will see that it shows a picture of a package containing a 3-pack of dog chews.  I did not get this bag, I recieved a single dog chew.  I was under the impression by looking at the description on the bag I was getting a single pkg of 3, Not just 1 dog chew.  This made these quite expensive and I ordered two :-(

column9: TOO PRICEY BUT GREAT TASTING CEREAL!!!
column10: Not that one could find this in the corner supermarket in this giant size (perhaps at Costco; I haven't checked), but the boxes of great tasting cereal are way too pricey here. I've switched to the original Special K and was able to get 4 smaller boxes at a more equitable price.

Celestial Seasonings Roastaroma tea has a intensely coffe-like aroma.  There is a distinctive flavour, which hints at something like coffee.  There is a somewhat bitter aftertaste if steeped too long.I am a Mormon and do not drink coffe or black/green tea.  I enjoyed coffee for years...quite the coffee lover as any of my family and friends would agree.  Giving it up was a hardship and I truly missed the flavour.Herbal teas are nice, but get old in a hurry and they need a bit of sweetening to really taste good.  Roastaroma can take a bit of sweetener, if that's how you liked your coffee.  I always use cream alone and it mellows the roastaroma nicely into an enjoyable cup.Overall a good product. Only drawback is it is nearly impossible to find at your local grocer.  Buying the product online requires the additional shipping and handling fees which really make the product quite expensive.

I am trying to kick my caffeine habit and cut calories at the same time. I stumbled on the Roastaroma tea and I am now absolutely convinced that this is my solution. The flavor is sweet and mild, yet close enough to actual coffee that it stands in nicely for the java I know and love. This is an excellent product and I highly recommend it!

This drink is a great product for those of us unable to ingest caffeine. But you'll probally have to do some tinkering around with it to get the appropriate 'coffee' flavor desired.It would help consumers if the company proactively suggested only making it with milk (of various kinds) to begin with (package directions?). Steeping it in mik is precisely what ended up making it taste like coffee.I was then unable to quit making cups for myself! I've gone through boxes so quickly, I know that I will have to start buying this product in bulk.Using water, you get black water with a faint hint of cinamon and other spices. And it won't taste like coffee.

column9: Cocoa like flavor, bold and roasty.
column10: I was happily surprised by this tea.  There is a hint of cinnamon smell to it, but it doesn't taste like cinnamon like most coffee substitutes.  I would say the flavor has a bit more cocoa than coffee, but it's still a great caffeine free alternatiev to coffee.  Another drink I would compare it to is a black stout beer (not Guiness, something darker).  I can't wait to try it with milk.  It's bold, dark, has a nice roast flavor, and is not sweet.

I have drank coffee for years and have now found myself needing to stop drinking it for health reasons. I have tried other coffee substitutes in the past and none of them were worth drinking or giving up coffee. I just bought this today at the health food store and it tastes as good if not better than any cup of coffee I have ever drank. Of coarse I did add my favorite creamer Coffee Mate Belgian Chocolate Toffee and a little Hazelnut stevia to it that made it so yummy. It wasn't weak like some teas can be when you're use to a bold cup of coffee. I believe I've finally found the coffee substitute that I will be able to use to stop drinking coffee and save a little money not going to Starbucks all the time. I highly recommend this to anyone wanting to have a great substitute for a good cup of coffee. Celestial Seasonings out did themselves with this incredible coffee substitute.

One of my all time favorite hot beverages. Rich flavor that can be enhanced with creamer and sweetener as one would with coffee. I often serve it at dinner parties and get raving reviews and new converts. Some have said they like the taste better than coffee.Natural food stores usually carry this. I suspect grocery stores will catch on soon as they are increasing their healthy choices to meet population demand. If they get enough requests, they'll add it to their herbal tea section.This is one I try to keep in my personal stock at all times.

Ive been trying to give up coffee, even decaf (sad face) for years but I always go back to it because finding a decent "coffee substitute" that gives that same warming comfort and mouthfeel is impossible.. you coffee drinkers know what I'm talking about.  I ran across roastaroma by accident and decided to give it a try.  The first cup wasnt bad! I actually loved it.  The cinnamon and anise are perfectly blended and you get that coffee-like aroma from the chocolate and chicory as well.  But I played around with it a little to perfect it to my taste and now I use 2 tea bags and steap for 5 minutes (I like a richer, bolder taste) and add my regular vanilla coffee creamer to it.  The creamer has just enough sweetness so that nothing else is needed.  As long as I can get this tea I'll be able to quit the coffee, it's just that good.

Landsakes, where has this tea been all my life?  I stumbled upon this tea at my local healthfood store just the other day and I had never heard of it before.  I am nursing at the moment and love coffee and tea.  However, I'm trying to stay away from caffeine and I know that decaf is not always healthy/tasting as good.  So I decided to try this.  Wow, its so delicious.  This tea actually does taste like coffee alot and smells great. This tea is very full bodied and tastes great with cream and honey if you want a delicious treat.
This infusion looks like coffee and tastes like nothing else. It has a roasty and slightly spicy flavor that pairs excellently with oatmeal.
Best strawberry tasting jelly beans ever!  Used maroon/red and orange for a college colors grad party and they tasted great!
The product was good but was not real distinctive between the varieties.  It was a nice conversation piece for the graduation party.

column9: He likes them, but I don't think he loves them...
column10: To be fair, our dog is spoiled.  He gets treats regularly.  Among his favorites are Zuke's Jerky Naturals Dog Treats, Lamb, 6-Ounce and Greenies Dental Chews for Dogs, Teenie Pack, 96 Chews.I thought I would try out the Wellness treats because we just switched him to the Wellness Super5Mix Dry Dog Food, Small Breed Adult Health Recipe, 12-Pound Bag and he LOVES it.  Before that, he was on Science Diet.  While he does like these treats, I have seen him snub away from them before.  He will, however, never snub away from a Zuke's.I will say that the Zuke's are more potent so maybe that's why he's drawn more to them.  The Wellness WellBites are a good product though.  The ingredients seem to be good and Wellness brand is recommended by our vet.I think we're going to stick with the Zuke's.  He likes them more and they're cheaper.  I would suggest trying both out for your pet, that's what we did.  There isn't too much of a price difference so it's worth a shot.I knocked one star off because he does not love them as much as the Zuke's.  I will probably try another flavor out in the future though to see if he likes those.
These are great. They're easily cut into smaller pieces--I cut each piece into 12 little treats. Each ends up being just 1 kcal per treat. I worry less about fattening up my pup during training.

What can I say? You get what you pay for and these Wellness WellBites are worth every dollar. My dog LOVES these treats so much; she'll do anything for them. She chooses them over some other high-end treats that it wouldn't be nice for me to name here. The WellBites are soft so you can easily break them into food, put them in toys, etc. And they're made with healthy ingredients. WellBites are a win-win: Tasty and Healthy. Excellent treat! Highly recommend!
Great for dogs with any skin allergy plus they love them.  Wellness makes great products to keep dogs healthy and fit.  Our boys love their products!

column9: Best training treats on the market.
column10: I love these and have used them since my dog was a puppy. The break apart really easily so that you can train with them. Super healthy with no by-products. Love these.

The treats in the bag are 1 x 1 squares and a little less than 1/2 a centimeter thick.  They are soft and they smell like a mild beef jerky.  My dog does not like treats that smell heavily of hickory, smoky flavors.  He loves these treats.  He is a Bichon Frise (5 yrs old).
Can you think of anything more unappetizing.  Not to dogs, they love these.  I just wish they were less expensive.
Our schnauzer loves these treats. We give them to her for training and as a reward for going into her crate. They are kind of large but soft so they are easy to tear into smaller pieces.

column9: my very picky puppy loves these
column10: I have been through so many treats for my puppy.  Trying to find something healthy that she actually likes has been a challenge.  But she loves these and she loves the Wellness Pure Rewards too.  My search is finally over.  And I love that they can be easily ripped into smaller pieces so I can use them in training without giving her too much at a time.

I taught my puppy how to sit using the puppy version of this product.  Now she's 11 months old, so I'm switching to the adult version.  Each treat is about twice the size of the puppy version and since my dog is only 5 lbs, I tear each treat into 4 pieces.  She absolutely loves these and they are a healthy treat for her.

I use these treats to put in the kong toys to give my three labs something to work on after I leave for work.  They love them.  They especially like the Lamb & Salmon flavor.  These are nice soft treats and I break them in half to make them last longer.
My doggies love these.  They are just the right size for a small dog and they are nice and soft!

column9: Wellness WellBites Dogs Treats, Lamb & Salmon
column10: My agility dogs run fast and clean(mostly) for Wellness WellBites Dogs Treats, Lamb & Salmon.  They just love these tasty, yet healthy, rewards. I love their increased attention/motivation on the course.  Thank you Amazon for carrying Wellness products.
My picky dog even likes these. They are easy to break up for training purposes. I will order them again.

column9: I have 2 dogs that love these
column10: One of my dogs will eat absolutely anything, but my new chihuahua puppy is the pickiest dog i have ever encountered. This is one of only 2 things he will actually eat without putting up a fight. (The other treat being the Happy Hips dog treats which are favorites for both my dogs.) We just finished our first bag and I'm here to restock since it went over so well. I'm still working to find/make a dog food he is happy with, but at least I've got the treats figured out.

MY 3 MONTH OLD MIX LAB/RETRIEVER (CHESTER MATEO) HAS TRIED beef & turkey AND lamb & salmon AND I JUST BOUGHT chicken & lamb. HE JUST LOVED THE 2 PREVIOUS ONES... THEY COME PRETTY BIG FOR HIM... SO I CUT IT IN 12 PIECES WHICH COMES OUT EXTREMELY SMALL... BUT I'M TRAINING HIM WITH THIS SO I GIVE HIM MANY PIECES DURING THE DAY... I DON'T WANT TO FATTEN HIM UP! LOL.... ALL I HAVE TO SAY IS THAT THE MOMENT HE SEES ME REACHING FOR HIS TREATS HE GOES CRAZY... SOMETIMES IT'S HARD TO TRAIN HIM BECAUSE HE JUST WANTS ME TO GIVE HIM THE TREATS!!!! LOL... THE GOOD THING IS THAT WHEN I'M TRAINING HIM OUTSIDE HE DOESN'T GET DISTRACTED BECAUSE HE WANTS THE TREATS MORE THAN EXPLORING!ONCE HE TRIES THE CHICKEN & LAMB... I'LL LET YOU KNOW HOW IT GOES! LOL
My two small dogs love these treats. When we put the bag up on the counter, our littlest actually tries to get up on the counter to get them. I wish there were bigger size options!
will  buy again am sticking with wellness products, purchased these the harder type snack good for her teeth than soft ones and she loves them  will buy again

I bought a bag of the turkey and duck treats to use during obedience training for my German Shepherd puppy.  She loves these treats and really responds to them.  These treats have a strong smoky smell that makes them very appealing.  I had a hard time training my puppy the "come" command until I started using Wellness treats.  Now she runs right to me because the treat is worth it!  Because the treats are expensive, I break each into about 4 or 6 little pieces.

Our little Maltese Shi Tsu mix is, what you might call picky. We have worked our way through a multitude of treats and Wellness Treats are the first thing we have found that she will actually beg for.

I bought these after finding them in the pet store and trying them with my dog. She loves them and when we go for walks I use these treats to keep her from straying too far from me. She will follow me anywhere for them. Thanks for the great price!
My 7 yo loves these! and she's about as picky as they get.  Because she are so small, the product lasts a long time.  The treats are so hard to find locally, that I turned to Amazon.

I give my three Shih Tzu's Wellness treats and they love them.  I love them as they are a fully nutritious treat.  Each piece is small and easily broken in half  when I want to simply "reward" the dogs for something they have done. Larger dogs would certainly want a larger "cookie" but for training treats, these would work well for any size dog.  I keep a variety of flavors around and when I ask if anyone wants a cookie, they all come running!
My favorite natural pet stores sell these for a higher price.  They fit perfectly into treat toys and my dog loves all of the flavors.
He loves them and would eat the entire bag, but we moderate the intake.  These are special occasional treats only.  And if we say "num num," he knows something special is going to happen.

My dogs love these treats!  I usually buy for them the Lamb WellBites but they love these Turkey bites as well.  Wellness is a great and natural dog food product that provides real food for your dogs and keeps any ingredients not natural or good for your dog's diet out of it's products.
My dog LOVES these! He's such an incredibly picky eater, I figured it would be another bag of treats so not worth buying, but boy was I wrong- he goes crazy for these treats!

column9: Easy to break up as training treats
column10: My dogs love these soft treats but then again, what dogs don't love soft treats? They are moist and stay soft after a few weeks. I tear them into two pieces for training. I will buy them again for value and quality.

I have a Teddy Bear breed puppy which loves to eat any snack that comes her way!!!!!  So i searched out a wholesome snack for her and decided on Wellness treats and she loves them and i don't feel quilty spoiling her with these!!!!!!

These are all he eats due to allergies.  They're soft and chewy, easy to break into pieces as a training treat.  He takes pills readily when they are served between two of these.  He always is excited to be offered this treat, even after 3 years.
My dogs love these treats!  They gobble them down so fast, I'm not sure they even taste them!  And I like knowing that I'm giving them a healthy treat.  Great product from a great pet food maker.
Haven't tasted these myself, but the dogs love them, and they are made in the U.S.A.

column9: Good Tasting Coffee, With A Kick - Recommended!
column10: This Green Mountain "Revv" makes a good tasting cup coffee that does seem to have more of a "kick" than the Coffee People, Donut Shop K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 50) I normally drink in the morning. While not as smooth, it is still an enjoyable flavor and it will wake you up.We use these in our Keurig B60 Special Edition Gourmet Single-Cup Home-Brewing System on the "Large" cup setting.Recommended!CFH

I was crazy about these as a kid! They are tubes simply filled with a flavored powdered candy that has tons of sugar in it. I first tried their wax paper tubes that were about 8 inches long when I was about 7 or 8 years old. Goes to figure that my 8 year old is nuts about these. We used to take our change to the local conveniance store. They came in grape, cherry, and orange, lime and other fruit flavors. Those were very good. But these are the big 21 inch thick plasitc tubes that hold the equivelant of 20 of the paper ones. This offer gets you a case of 50 of the big plastic tubes, in grape, maui punch, cherry, and orange flavors. Lots of fun from the Wonka factory.
Just what I wanted.  I hadn't been able to find them in stores.  My students will love getting these as special birthday treats.

column9: Very pleased. Arrived quickly and was exactly what I expected.
column10: For anyone interested in this product, I'll tell you what I use it for--ice cream. I love to pour pixy stick candy on top of vanilla ice cream! I'm so happy this candy is still being made.
These were just what I wanted and the quantity was good for the price. packageing was not that great, some were leaking. Otherwise they were fresh and everyone loved them.

Students LOVE pixy stix and they love the giant ones even more.  This is a great sell for a fundraiser.  I only bought 50 stix for my last event and they sold out in the first 20 min.  I plan to buy many more in the future.
These were thehi HIT of Halloween.  Kids all screamed they got "Giant Pixi Stix" after receiving them. They were also a nostalgic hit at the office the next day.

Wow i remember these suckers back in the day. I didn't have enough energy that I had to add these to my body to even be more wilder? of course! Nothing is better than to supercharge your day with these... its like being given super powers.... well for like 20 minutes then you massively crash into a unenergetic state that makes you sleepy. Though these are still good just have them in moderation unless you can afford to be lazt and do nothing for most of the day.

column9: Totally different brand was sent to me, from concentrate. not as advertised.
column10: "Totally different brand was sent to me.. and it says from concentrate. even though it says not concentrate on the site. disappointed. "Not-from-concentrate juices have that right-from-the-grove, fresh-squeezed taste. " -Yeah right.."

I was really surprised by the good taste of this mix. The only downside is that it is grainy- at least, it is for me, but I simply dump a packet in water and stir it in. Perhaps using a blender and adding ice would lessen the graininess of it, but I bought it in the individual packets for the on-the-go convenience. I make green juice or green smoothies nearly daily, so I'm quite used to a much "greener" taste than this provides- this is actually quite sweet and I consider it a treat! I'm going to reorder this and keep it on hand.
I enjoy Amazing Grass products so I purchased this.  The flavor left a rather unpleasant aftertase.  So far this is the only product with this brand that I have not liked at all.

I mix one packet with 8oz of organic milk. Tastes like a sweetened green drink, good but not great. There is a tiny bit of graininess to it; but miner and didn't distract from a pleasant and refreshing drink. I have not used long enough to comment on any possible health benefits.
I could not find this in the grocery stores.This is glass.  The pastic cap fits well.Shake well before each use.

There's really nothing like making your own salad dressing.Of course most of this one comes out of a packet but I use my own red wine vinegar and sunflower oil.With very little work, it's delicious - all the flavors are good.Highly recommend this product - note the 'very little work' and 'delicious'Works for me :)
Wanted this because my mom had one when I was growing up and always used it. I finally found it, and i love how easy it is to make the dressings.

Had a bit of a time finding this product locally, but was finally successful. It was a bit less expensive than ordering online, but the frustration of trying to find it... I would have been better off to order it online. I LOVE the taste of the product which helps me to eat more raw vegetables and salads. I hate hate hate making salads at home (though I will eat them at restaurants), but the taste of the Good Seasons dressing is a motivator. Raw carrots, cucumber slices, sliced Heirloom or grape tomatoes, lightly steamed broccoli - I'll eat them as long as I have my Good Seasons dressing to dip them into. I also use it as a marinade for chicken and turkey breasts to keep them moist and give them much needed flavor.

column9: Great product, hard to find at my grocery store
column10: Very happy to find this Cruet combo here on Amazon.  Shopping Star vendor sells at store prices and almost next day delivery.Most grocery stores do not stock this Cruet dressing set anymore for some reason. Best Italian tasting dressing you can make or modify to your own taste. Will be stocking up on this item!

I have looked in every single store for one of these cruets and couldn't find one.  I am so happy I was able to purchase one online.  The order was shipped without delay and now I am enjoying my favorite dressing on my salads, just in time for summer.

column9: It was as expected and the mixes were not expired.
column10: This product (carafe with lid) used to be in the stores, next to the Good Seasons salad mixes and for some reason all of my local stores were no longer carrying the carafe?!?It was good to be able to find on line, though I just needed a new lid.  I tried to find a new lid, but couldn't without the carafe.I am now using the product and it works just fine.

I have recently been looking for this Cruet in our local grocery stores to no avail.  My Mom had one when I was a kid and I decided that I wanted one.  I forgot how much I loved Good Seasons Italian Dressing until my friend served it during a party.  It truly is the best tasting dressing! I absolutely LOVE IT!
The product was as described and exactly what I wanted.  The delivery was quick.  Good service.

You really can find these for 2 bucks a piece in the grocery store if you look hard enough or just ask a store employee. I found them a couple of days after ordering these at my local super market for $2.50 each. Bought 4 of them - I use them for BBQ sauce.
I couldn't find this Good Seasons bottle at the supermarket but found it here.  The bottle was delivered promptly and was exactly what I was looking for.

Received Cruet and dressing mix. I loved this dressing as a child and wanted to find the cruet that came with it. Could not find it in any stores was glad to see it online. I am now enjoying my dressing on my salads..

column9: New flavor of rice mix ~ Coconut Raisin Rice
column10: This rice is what I like ~ whole grain brown rice with a hint of coconut, and the best part is there is no artificial ingredients in it ! That makes it one hell of a healthy meal.I saw the recipe on the back of the box for coconut shrimp rice. Although I did not follow exactly the recipe, I added sauteed shrimps with mushrooms & peas plus a splash of lime juice. Then I experimented by splashing lime juice over the cooked rice and it taste fabulous !However, I wanted to point out the cooking time seems to take more than 25 mins than what it said on the box....it took me 35 mins to cook the rice and I added exactly 2.5 cups of water as per instructions. After all, I am very happy I bought the rice and will continue to do so and bring something different to my dinner table.

column9: This is what I've been looking for!
column10: It seems like all I ever drink is water and I know I STILL don't drink enough. It's just so boring after awhile. I've been trying to find a water I would be able to drink more of every day without missing Gatorade.I tried vitamin water but it's made with so much sugar and the zero version has stevia in it which has the WORST aftertaste IMO. I looked into a few different drinks and then I found this. No sugar. Nothing artificial, just water and flavor--actually a bit more than a hint.I've tried many of the flavors and, I'm sure some people would disagree with me but these are my thoughts on them:This flavor (pomegranate/tangerine)-- really nice. Refreshing. I drank it during a hard work out and it tasted clean. I actually finished it halfway through the work out (a first for me) and wanted more. ordering a case right now.Blackberry -- really nice. A teeny bit sweet but Not overly so.Hibiscus/honeydew -- CLOYINGLY sweet. I actually double checked the label to make sure there really was no sugar in it.Watermelon -- not as sweet as honeydew but still a little too sweet for everyday drinking for me.Cucumber -- if it's really cold, it can be somewhat refreshing in a spa kind of way. But mostly I had to pretend it didn't taste like water filtered through grass.Strawberry/kiwi and grapefruit-- blech. Not my favorite flavors in anything so I'm not a good judge.Pom/tangerine and blackberry were best IMO and now I'm trying lime too.Really like this product. Hopefully there won't be some upcoming exposé about how the "natural flavors" cause cancer or something (as seems to happen with many things I like) lolUPDATE: tried the lime...UGH!!! Tastes like there's something wrong with it. Almost chemical flavor but not. Weird. I hated it and I wasn't the only one.

As I have said in other reviews, I normally hate flavored water. Hint is just the right amount of flavor to give water a delicious edge.It has the added benefit of satisfying a craving for something sweet without going to soda or candy.The water is a much healthier alternative to other forms of flavor indulgence.I highly recommend the Pomegranate-Tangerine flavor. I think it is their best flavor.

I have been looking for a water like this since the last company that made this type of water went under. (can't remember the name its been so long) I absolutely abhor artificial sweetener, but water gets so old sometimes, you just want a little flavor! Well this is it folks, if you're like me and can't stand sucralose etc this should stand out for you. Still water but with a lovely 'Hint' of flavor. I tried the blackberry and it was tasty too, but the pomegranate-tangerine is AWESOME! I'm going to drink this until I can't stand it anymore.

column9: Possibly the best of the hint flavors!
column10: Let's see now.  As of this point, I've tried the pear, the raspberry lime, the tropical punch, and now this one,  My least favorite now is the pear,  I'm on automatic reorder with the tropical punch.  And I think I am going to do the same with this one,  It's terrific too,  But the raspberry lime is no slouch either!  As everyone knows, we're all being harped upon to drink more water,  Something most people are remiss in doing,  I drink a fair  amount, more than most, I bet,  However, this line of hinted waters makes it a whole lot easier.  It stymies me HOW they do it,  With no chemicals, no added weird and noxious things,  Best maybe they keep the secret to themselves,  Try it, you'll like it,

This gets 5 stars for being what it says.  It's a hint of flavor - and that's all, a hint.  It's refreshing, tastes good and clean, and best of all 0 calories.  I stopped ordering it because I was looking for more than a hint of flavor - okay I know.  Would I buy it instead of plain bottled water at the same price point?  Absolutely yes.  But I don't buy bottled water.  As silly as this sounds, if you're only looking for a hint of refreshing clean flavor then this is for you.

column9: great tast with out the sugar or any fake stuff
column10: I love this product ! its the best with out any cal!Just wish it was sold closer to home. Love the cucumber too
This is the best flavored water I've ever tried, plus there are no calories, sugar, carbs, artificial sweeteners or sodium.

As with most people who select flavored water, I choose it when I don't want sugary drinks or artificial sweetners, but want something a little more than plain water.I found this flavor to be weak, which is expected with flavored water, but also found it to be unpleasant.To me this tasted like when you're eating an orange, and you get a bit of orange rind.  It very much had that orange oil, bitter taste.I won't be buying this flavor again.

Hint water is fantastic. I drink a ton of water, but sometimes I want something with flavor. Juice is too sweet, loaded with sugar and other unnecessary ingredients. I prefer simplicity and this product is just that. The flavor ir very subtle so if you are looking for a strong flavor, this is not for you.

column9: Just the right amount of flavor!
column10: I am addicted to this water!  I think that the pomegranate-tangerine and blackberry are the tastiest flavors.  I love that it offers a "hint" of flavor without being sweet, since most flavored waters are sweet and full of calories.  I've been buying this via 'subscribe & save' for months now and still love it!The biggest downside to drinking Hint water is that it's tough to go back to drinking plain water :)

Excellent taste, very natural and subtle hint of orange and pomegranate. I can't stand artificial sweeteners - so synthetic and they all have an aftertaste - but plain water can be a bit dull. I also love the blackberry flavor.
Tangerines are my favorite.  Thought I would love it.  Was pretty disappointed at the lack of flavor (I know it's a Hint but I needed more of one!).  It's not worth the cost vs. regular water.
This one tasted better!  I like to drink water without sweetner but with some flavor.  This works for me.

column9: Refreshing delicious way to get your water
column10: I've become a fan of Hint water over the last year and tried a couple of the flavors.  I like the Pomegranate-Tangerine but am also partial to the Grapefruit flavor.  It's more of a personal preference than anything else so if you know you like these flavors, chances are you'll find these waters delicious.I enjoy how these taste when chilled.  I have also drank them at the gym a little less cold and find it is much better when straight from the refrigerator since the flavors are more strong.  As the name implies, it is just a hint of flavor, not meant to taste overly sweet or like a juice.  I prefer this, but some people might find the flavor not intense enough for their liking.Purchasing these on Amazon is so helpful since you can order in bulk and get a great deal and not have to carry or transport a heavy case home.

This USED to be my FAVORITE WATER - and SPLURGE!  Unfortunately, the new label and the new formula ... JUST DON'T GET IT ANYMORE.  VERY, VERY, VERY HINT of FLAVOR left in the changed product.  SO Disappointed.  I have CANCELLED my Subscription!HINT COMPANY - Please bring back the old formula.  It was (HINT) PERFECT the way it was!

I seldom if ever give a negative review, but to put it bluntly, this stuff was bad. I tried this product based on its label of "Premium Essence Water", and the flavor sounded good too (Pomegranate-Tangerine). The first thing I noticed before opening the bottle was the amount of debris/particles/sediment floating inside the water while the sun was reflected into the bottle. I decided to still go ahead and try it and was quite unimpressed. The water had a flavor of industrial tap water, the kind you get in a large city, that is processed at the water plant nestled next to the sewer plant. There was a 'hint' of some flavor, though I couldn't pinpoint it. I gave the high 2-star rating because it would probably still be effective at dousing a fire.

I received a sample of this from the San Francisco Vegetarian Society's table during the 40th IVU conference.  Each packet has individually gold foil wrapped bouillon cubes which gets big points for keeping the cubes sanitary and safe.  I decided to try it as a cup of soup.  It took a little bit of stirring because the cubes are pretty solid.  The wait was worth it because the soup/broth was delicious and tastes so much like homemade chicken soup.  I love how I can have the flavor with out the saturated fats and cholesterol.  I can hardly wait to try the beef and veg cubes.  I will be using this in my cooking also but I love how I can have a nice warm cup of soup whenever I want now...guilt free!

column9: When they say whole they mean WHOLE!
column10: Another excellent product.  This reminds me of a dish we make back home, in the Philippines.  These kind of reminds me of this dish.  the sauce is nice and thick and rich.  But be warned, they are whole squid, innards and all.  Very delicious!

So not too much to review. But its just as good as it is anywhere else. Price is right (maybe the 64oz one is better, but its HUGE!) this is a good size that you can handle to put on rice. mmmmmm, had some tonight. Was fantastic!

column9: I can't believe you're actually reading this review.
column10: This is soy sauce, people. It's black and salty; and it's in pretty much every Asian dish there is.At least for Japanese people, Kikkoman is the gold standard. It's hard to describe what soy sauce is supposed to taste like, but Kikkoman is it. No funny after taste... no tinny flavor like some of those other cheap-o brands.The only time I would even think of using anything other than Kikkoman is when I'm cooking something that wouldn't do well with the addition of liquid (e.g. stir fried veggies. Extra liquid makes them soggy.) At those times, and only at those times, I use condensed soy sauce; which Kikkoman apparently doesn't make.

Bought this to use with my Senseo machine, since the Senseo pods were discontinued at my local grocer. Perfect fit. The pods are a bit fuller than the originals but works without any leaks... Coffee is good quality also!

my best friend introduced white pepper to meso i went online and tried to get her others for her to tryi liked the fact that she used up this one (meaning she loved this one best)liek the description says, its like regular pepper, with a touch of sweetnessi hate the fact though that they are so light it is impossible to use a peppermill with them. you are almost forced to just eat them whole

column9: Pricing seems way out of line.

Plus, what is a "used" capsule?  Somehow this whole category is not worthy of Amazon with these prices and items.
